read_sections.body_en:
Nestor, 41, and the families have confirmed scheduling and childcare barriers in the example. They need the midwife and other partners to plan a response.

If scheduling and childcare are the barriers, another poster may be insufficient. Compare two proposals: a poster alone, or discussion with the health center and households about a more accessible schedule. Which addresses the verified cause? Who can implement it? What time, people and costs are involved? Do not promise a new service or funding until the responsible authority agrees.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Nestor, 41, at ang mga pamilya ay nakumpirmang ang iskedyul at childcare ang hadlang sa mga pagbisita sa halimbawa. Kailangan nila ang midwife at iba pang katuwang para magplano.

Kung schedule at childcare ang hadlang, baka hindi sapat ang dagdag na poster. Ihambing ang dalawang mungkahi: bagong poster lamang, o pakikipag-usap sa health center at mga pamilya tungkol sa mas naaabot na schedule. Alin ang tumatama sa natiyak na sanhi? Sino ang may kakayahang magpatupad? May oras, tao at gastusin ba? Huwag mangakong may bagong serbisyo o pondo hangga’t hindi ito napagkasunduan ng may awtoridad.
read_sections.heading_en: Match the solution to the cause
read_sections.takeaway_en: Compare solutions against the cause and resources, not convenience alone.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Paghambingin ang solusyon ayon sa sanhi at resources, hindi sa dali lamang ng paggawa.

read_sections.body_en: Nestor proposes a simple plan: consult affected households this week, send aggregated preferred times to the midwife, and discuss one trial schedule with the barangay health planning team. Name an owner, resources, deadline and measure, such as attendance among those invited. On the review date, ask whether the barrier decreased, not merely whether a meeting happened. Confirm each partner’s contribution first.
read_sections.body_fil: Gumawa si Nestor ng simpleng plano: kausapin ang mga apektadong pamilya ngayong linggo; isumite sa midwife ang pinagsama-samang preferred times; talakayin ang isang pagsubok na schedule sa barangay health planning team. Tukuyin ang responsable, kailangang resources, deadline at sukatan—halimbawa, bilang ng nakadalo sa mga inimbitahan. Sa review date, itanong kung nabawasan ang hadlang, hindi lang kung natapos ang meeting. Kumpirmahin muna ang ambag ng bawat kasosyo.

read_sections.takeaway_en: A recommendation becomes a plan when it names an owner, resources, date and outcome measure.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang rekomendasyon ay nagiging plano kapag may responsable, resources, petsa at sukatan ng resulta.

read_sections.body_en: A BHW cannot alone fix transport, water and service schedules. On the problem map, mark actions within the BHW’s role, issues for the health team, and needs requiring barangay or other agencies. Include affected residents, particularly those who seldom attend meetings. Report patterns without unnecessary personal details and return to residents with the agreement.
read_sections.body_fil: Hindi kayang ayusin ng BHW mag-isa ang transportasyon, tubig at schedule ng serbisyo. Sa problem map, markahan kung ano ang maaaring gawin ng BHW, alin ang kailangang iakyat sa health team, at alin ang nangangailangan ng barangay o ibang ahensya. Anyayahan ang mga residenteng apektado, kabilang ang hindi madalas makadalo sa pulong. Iulat ang pattern na walang personal na detalyeng hindi kailangan. Balikan sila tungkol sa napagkasunduan.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Solutions need owners and partners; not every task belongs to the BHW.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang solusyon ay may may-ari at kasosyo; hindi lahat ng gawain ay ibinabagsak sa BHW.

read_sections.body_en: The schedule moved earlier but two households still missed the visit. Do not label the families as failures. Recheck barriers: did work, costs or notice change? Compare invitations and attendance before and after the trial. Identify which assumption was wrong and what small change to try. One small trial does not prove the whole problem is solved.
read_sections.body_fil: Naging mas maaga ang schedule pero dalawa pa rin ang hindi nakadalo. Huwag agad sabihing bigo ang pamilya. Kumustahin ang access barrier: may pagbabago ba sa trabaho, gastos o abiso? Ihambing ang bilang ng inimbitahan at nakadalo bago at matapos ang pagsubok. Tukuyin kung aling palagay ang mali at anong maliit na pagbabago ang susubukan. Ang isang maliit na trial ay hindi patunay na nalutas na ang buong problema.

## [purpose] Layunin

Magmungkahi ng isang trial na tumutugon sa natiyak na sanhi, may owner, resources, deadline, sukatan at petsa ng review, na may pagsang-ayon ng katuwang.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

50 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 3 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang pitong field sa papel. Linawin kung sino ang maaaring magdesisyon sa lokal na iskedyul at resources.

## [opening] Pambungad

Nagawa ang meeting ngunit hindi dumami ang nakarating. Ano ang tamang review?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang ikatlong sagot ay sumusukat sa resulta. Ang meeting ay gawain, hindi patunay na nawala ang hadlang; ang basta pag-uulit ay maaaring maulit ang maling palagay.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Nangangako ng bagong iskedyul o pondo nang walang pahintulot, o meeting count lamang ang sukatan. Ang plano ay may taong kikilos at paraan upang malaman kung bumaba ang hadlang.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Punan: sanhi; mungkahi; owner; kailangan; deadline; sukatan; review date. Ihambing ang poster at trial schedule bago pumili. Magpares: isa ang midwife na magtatanong kung may pagsang-ayon at resources. Baguhin ang plano at ulitin ang isang minutong rekomendasyon. Kung mag-isa, sagutin ang parehong tanong. Dalhin ang mungkahi sa susunod na team meeting bago ipatupad.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

3. Balikan ang hadlang at ihambing ang invitations at attendance bago magbago.

Ang ikatlong sagot ay sumusukat sa resulta. Ang meeting ay gawain, hindi patunay na nawala ang hadlang; ang basta pag-uulit ay maaaring maulit ang maling palagay.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Naiuugnay ang mungkahi sa sanhi; kumpleto ang owner, resources, deadline, sukatan at review; may partner agreement at paliwanag kung paano babaguhin kapag hindi gumana.

Kaya na: Naiuugnay ang mungkahi sa sanhi; kumpleto ang owner, resources, deadline, sukatan at review; may partner agreement at paliwanag kung paano babaguhin kapag hindi gumana. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Tumutugon sa sanhi ngunit kulang ang owner o sukatan; ipapunan ang plan card bago muling magpresenta.

Hindi pa: Nangangako ng bagong iskedyul o pondo nang walang pahintulot, o meeting count lamang ang sukatan.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Tumutugon sa sanhi ngunit kulang ang owner o sukatan; ipapunan ang plan card bago muling magpresenta. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 29; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 19, 20, 21. Ang source table ay larawan; minana ang beripikadong interpretasyon ng naunang implementation plan. Ang Rosario case ay hiwalay na ZFF source. Hindi clinical advice ang kasaysayan. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.

## [purpose] Purpose

Recommend a trial addressing a verified cause, with an owner, resources, deadline, measure and review date, subject to partner agreement.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

50 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 3 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare the seven fields on paper. Clarify who can decide on local schedules and resources.

## [opening] Opening

The meeting happened but attendance did not improve. What review is useful?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The third response examines results. A meeting is an activity, not proof that a barrier disappeared; repetition may preserve the wrong assumption.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Promises a new schedule or funding without agreement, or measures only meetings held. A plan names who acts and how to tell whether the barrier decreased.

## [practice] Practice activity

Fill in: cause; proposal; owner; resources; deadline; measure; review date. Compare a poster and trial schedule before choosing. In pairs, the midwife asks about agreement and resources. Revise and repeat the one-minute recommendation. Alone, answer the same questions. Bring the proposal to the next team meeting before implementation.

## [answer-key] Answer key

3. Recheck barriers and compare invitations with attendance before revising.

The third response examines results. A meeting is an activity, not proof that a barrier disappeared; repetition may preserve the wrong assumption.

## [observe] Observe

Links the proposal to the cause, specifies owner, resources, deadline, measure and review, seeks partner agreement and explains how to revise if it fails.

Ready: Links the proposal to the cause, specifies owner, resources, deadline, measure and review, seeks partner agreement and explains how to revise if it fails. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Addresses the cause but omits an owner or measure; complete the plan card before presenting again.

Not yet: Promises a new schedule or funding without agreement, or measures only meetings held.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Addresses the cause but omits an owner or measure; complete the plan card before presenting again. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 29; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 19, 20, 21. The source table is an image; this draft inherits the earlier implementation plan’s verified interpretation. Rosario is a separate ZFF case source. The historical account is not clinical advice. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

objectives_en: From conflicting accounts, produce a record separating reports, observations and unconfirmed details, with a way to verify the gap.

read_sections.body_en: Gibs, a male BHW, visits Liza, 29, for an authorized household profile. He asks permission and listens first. Liza says: “Getting there is difficult when nobody can look after my two children.” The neighbor says: “She is not interested.” This rehearsal is not an actual record. Separate four columns: Liza’s report, the neighbor’s report, direct observations, and unconfirmed details. When the appointment card is requested, Gibs observes that no card is shown during the conversation. This does not prove that Liza had no appointment or did not attend. Gibs has not seen the authorized attendance record. The visit date and status remain unconfirmed. A nod, silence or glance toward the door is only an observation, not proof of agreement, refusal, feelings or a diagnosis.
read_sections.body_fil: Si Gibs, isang lalaking BHW, ay bumisita kay Liza, 29, para sa awtorisadong household profile. Nagpaalam siya at nakinig muna. Sinabi ni Liza: “Mahirap pumunta kapag walang magbabantay sa dalawang anak ko.” Sabi ng kapitbahay: “Hindi siya interesado.” Sa pagsasanay na ito, hindi ito aktuwal na rekord. Ihiwalay ang apat na hanay: sinabi ni Liza, iniulat ng kapitbahay, direktang nakita, at hindi pa natiyak. Nang hilingin ang appointment card, nakita ni Gibs na walang card na naipakita sa pag-uusap. Hindi nito pinatutunayang walang appointment o hindi pumunta si Liza. Hindi pa nakita ni Gibs ang awtorisadong attendance record. Ang petsa at status ng pagbisita ay hindi pa nakumpirma. Ang pagtango, pananahimik o pagtingin sa pinto ay obserbasyon lamang, hindi patunay ng pagsang-ayon, pagtanggi, damdamin o diagnosis.
read_sections.heading_fil: Sinabi, nakita, at hindi pa tiyak
read_sections.takeaway_en: When assessing information, distinguish reports, observations and details still requiring verification.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Sa pagsusuri ng impormasyon, ihiwalay ang sinabi, nakita at kailangan pang beripikahin.

read_sections.body_en: “This is for an authorized household profile and health-service planning,” Gibs explains. “Only relevant information will be used by the authorized health team under local policy. May we clarify the barrier to getting there?” Liza chooses Filipino and a quieter place. The access barrier is relevant to this task; gossip about the neighbor’s debt is not. Real names or addresses are unnecessary on the rehearsal sheet. Do not guess missing entries on an official form. Explaining information use is not a promise of absolute secrecy. For questions about correction, access or keeping records, ask the authorized custodian about the actual local process; do not invent a universal form or deletion date. If immediate help is needed, follow the local process and do not delay it to finish the interview.
read_sections.body_fil: “Para po ito sa awtorisadong household profile at pagpaplano ng serbisyong pangkalusugan,” paliwanag ni Gibs. “Kaugnay na impormasyon lamang ang gagamitin ng awtorisadong health team ayon sa lokal na patakaran. Maaari po ba nating linawin ang hadlang sa pagpunta?” Pinili ni Liza ang Filipino at isang mas tahimik na lugar. Ang hadlang sa pagpunta ay kaugnay ng gawaing ito; ang tsismis tungkol sa utang ng kapitbahay ay hindi. Hindi kailangan ang tunay na pangalan o address sa papel ng pagsasanay. Huwag hulaan ang patlang sa opisyal na form. Hindi pangako ng ganap na lihim ang paliwanag sa paggamit. Kung may tanong tungkol sa pagwawasto, access o pag-iingat ng rekord, itanong ang aktuwal na lokal na proseso sa awtorisadong tagapangasiwa; huwag mag-imbento ng iisang form o petsa ng pagbura. Kung kailangan ng agarang tulong, sundin ang lokal na proseso at huwag itong ipagpaliban para matapos ang interview.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Record only what the authorized task needs; explain its use and follow local policy.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Itala lamang ang kailangan sa awtorisadong gawain; ipaliwanag ang gamit at sundin ang lokal na patakaran.

read_sections.body_en: Liza says: “The schedule was canceled.” The neighbor says: “She did not want to go.” Gibs does not choose a story because one voice is louder. “What do you mean by canceled?” he asks Liza. “I could not go when my sister was away. I am not sure whether the center canceled it,” she clarifies. Gibs summarizes: “You could not go when your sister was away; the schedule status is still uncertain. Is that right?” “Yes,” Liza replies. Record this as Liza’s clarification, keeping the source of the first statement and its correction clear. If the neighbor’s report is relevant to the task, attribute it to the neighbor; it is not proof of Liza’s motive. Trust and careful verification work together. Do not label a resident dishonest or noncompliant merely because accounts differ.
read_sections.body_fil: Sabi ni Liza: “Kinansela ang schedule.” Sabi ng kapitbahay: “Ayaw niyang pumunta.” Hindi pipili si Gibs dahil mas malakas ang boses ng isa. “Ano po ang ibig ninyong sabihin sa kinansela?” tanong niya kay Liza. “Hindi ako nakapunta noong wala ang kapatid ko. Hindi ko tiyak kung kinansela ng center,” paglilinaw niya. Ibinuod ni Gibs: “Hindi kayo nakapunta nang wala ang kapatid ninyo; hindi pa tiyak ang status ng schedule. Tama po ba?” “Opo,” sagot ni Liza. Itala ang paglilinaw bilang sinabi ni Liza at panatilihing malinaw ang pinagmulan ng unang pahayag at pagwawasto. Kung mahalaga sa gawain ang ulat ng kapitbahay, iugnay ito sa kanya; hindi ito katunayan ng motibo ni Liza. Ang pagtitiwala at maingat na pagberipika ay magkasabay. Huwag tawaging sinungaling o hindi sumusunod ang residente dahil lamang magkaiba ang kuwento.
read_sections.takeaway_en: When accounts differ, clarify and verify before deciding.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Kapag magkaiba ang kuwento, maglinaw at magberipika bago magpasya.

read_sections.body_en: Incorrect initial note: “The center canceled the appointment.” It treats unconfirmed information as established. Gibs corrects the fictional practice sheet: “Liza first reported a canceled schedule. Liza clarified during the conversation that she could not attend when her sister was away and was unsure whether the center canceled it. No card was shown. Date and status: not yet confirmed.” He does not replace one guess with another. One suitable step is to ask the authorized midwife to check the relevant attendance record with him under the local access procedure. Ask only what is needed; do not investigate Liza’s entire life. Liza confirms the summary of her own report and is willing to clarify the date she remembers. That is the confirmed ending of the conversation, not confirmation of attendance or a new appointment. Until suitable verification is available, keep the gap marked “not yet confirmed.” In a real record, follow the local correction process and preserve the source of the change.
read_sections.body_fil: Maling paunang tala: “Kinansela ng center ang appointment.” Ginawa nitong tiyak ang hindi pa natiyak. Iwinasto ni Gibs sa kathang-isip na practice sheet: “Unang sinabi ni Liza: kinansela ang schedule. Paglilinaw ni Liza sa pag-uusap: hindi siya nakapunta nang wala ang kapatid; hindi niya tiyak kung kinansela ng center. Walang card na naipakita. Petsa at status: hindi pa nakumpirma.” Hindi niya pinalitan ang hula ng panibagong hula. ## [purpose] Layunin

Mula sa dalawang magkaibang kuwento, gumawa ng tala na hiwalay ang sinabi, nakita at hindi pa natiyak, at tukuyin kung paano beripikahin ang kulang.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

90 minutong facilitated practice: 10 pambungad + 15 demonstration + 30 tatlong triad round + 20 pagwawasto/beripikasyon + 10 debrief + 5 exit check = 90. Ang limang aralin ay 90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90 = 480 minuto; ang shared module outline ay ibang pagtingin sa parehong programa, hindi dagdag na walong oras. Papel, lapis, bilingual role cards, observer checklist at recording aid. Walang totoong rekord. Ginawang pagtataya ng sariling pag-aaral: 11–14 minuto, ayon sa mas mahabang salaysay. Aktuwal na salaysay ng anim na screen: 400.61 segundo sa English at 446.30 segundo sa Filipino; maglaan ng 3–6 minuto para sa check, maikling pagsasanay at pagninilay. Dagdag pa ang opsyonal na kuwento o pag-ulit.

## [prepare] Paghahanda

Para sa 30 kalahok, bumuo ng sampung triad at lagyan ng numerong 1–10. Iprint ang apat na A4 page bawat wika: BHW, residente, tagamasid na may checklist, recording aid. Ipakita muna ang larawan bago ang check; huwag ibigay ang ending o tamang sagot. Ihanda ang source cards A–F. Ipatsek sa lokal na awtorisadong tagapangasiwa ang layunin, access, correction at retention procedure bago aktuwal na paggamit. Kung wala pa, gamitin lamang bilang kathang-isip na rehearsal; huwag mag-imbento ng patakaran.

## [opening] Pambungad · 10 minuto

Itanong: “Kapag walang card na naipakita, ano lamang ang direktang nakita? Ano ang hindi pa natin alam?” Inaasahan: walang card na naipakita sa pag-uusap; hindi nito pinatutunayan ang kawalan ng appointment o hindi pagpunta. Ipakilala si Gibs at Liza at ang apat na hanay. Walang obligasyong magbahagi ng sariling kuwento. Ihiwalay ang impormasyon sa diagnosis, husga o imbestigasyon.

## [steps] Demonstration at daloy

15 minuto: basahin ang sources at relevant-detail. Sabihin bilang Gibs: “Para po ito sa awtorisadong household profile. Kaugnay na impormasyon lamang ang gagamitin ng awtorisadong health team ayon sa lokal na patakaran. Maaari po ba tayong maglinaw?” Bilang Liza: “Kinansela ang schedule.” Gibs: “Ano po ang ibig ninyong sabihin sa kinansela?” Liza: “Hindi ako nakapunta noong wala ang kapatid ko. Hindi ko tiyak kung kinansela ng center.” Gibs: “Hindi kayo nakapunta nang wala ang kapatid; hindi pa tiyak ang status. Tama po ba?” Liza: “Opo.” Ipakita ang maling note at ang attributed correction mula verify-gap. Sabihin: “Ito ang kumpirmadong buod ng sinabi, hindi kumpirmasyon ng attendance.” Kathang-isip na dialogue ito, hindi sipi ng DOH. Pagkatapos: 30 minuto sa mga triad round, 20 minuto sa pagwawasto/beripikasyon, 10 minuto sa debrief at 5 minuto sa exit check.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

A at E: ayon kay Liza. B: ayon sa kapitbahay; opinyon sa interes, hindi natiyak na motibo. C: direktang nakita lamang. D: hindi pa natiyak. F: hindi kaugnay, alisin. Ang paglilinaw ni Liza ay reported correction. Ang angkop na beripikasyon: kaugnay na attendance record kasama ang awtorisadong midwife, ayon sa access procedure. Hindi inaasahang malaman ang tunay na petsa dahil wala ito sa cards.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Pagpapalit ng “ayon kay” sa tiyak na katotohanan; pag-aakalang walang card kaya hindi pumunta; pagpili sa pinakamalakas na boses; pagsulat ng diagnosis o “sinungaling”; paghulang petsa; pagsama ng tsismis; pag-aakalang pagtango ang patunay ng lahat; pagbura ng pinagmulan ng correction. Itanong: “Aling card ang ebidensya mo? Report ba o nakita? Ano ang hindi pa tiyak?” Huwag gawing grado ang peer feedback.

## [practice] Pagsasanay at debrief

30 minuto: tatlong round na tig-10 (5 attempt + 3 feedback + 2 retry). A/B/C roles: BHW/residente/tagamasid → tagamasid/BHW/residente → residente/tagamasid/BHW. Lahat ay susubok bilang BHW. Ang kapitbahay ay printed source card, hindi ikaapat na actor. 20 minuto: suriin at iwasto ang tala; salungguhitan ang pinagmulan at isulat ang isang angkop na beripikasyon. 10 debrief: “Ano ang binago matapos maglinaw? Ano ang hindi pa tiyak? Bakit hindi natin isasama ang F? Ano ang pinatunayan ni Liza at ano ang hindi?” Inaasahan: attributed correction; hindi pa tiyak na petsa/status; walang kaugnayan ang utang; buod lamang ang kinumpirma. 5 exit check: pumili, ipaliwanag at ihambing sa sariling tala.

## [answer-key] Susi sa check

2. “Ayon kay Liza, kinansela ang schedule; petsa ay ibeberipika sa rekord.”

Una: kahit may “ayon sa kapitbahay,” ang “hindi interesado” ay husga sa motibo, hindi natiyak na katotohanan. Ikalawa: ang ulat ay malinaw na kay Liza at may puwang na ibeberipika; ito ang angkop na paunang tala. Ikatlo: hindi pinatutunayan ng isang ulat na kinansela ang lahat ng appointment. Sa wakas, nilinaw ni Liza na hindi siya nakapunta nang wala ang kapatid at hindi niya tiyak kung kinansela ng center. Iwinastong tala: unang sinabi ni Liza ang pagkansela; nilinaw niya ang hadlang at kawalan ng katiyakan. Walang card na naipakita. Hindi pa nakumpirma ang petsa/status; hilingin sa awtorisadong midwife na tingnan ang kaugnay na rekord ayon sa lokal na access procedure. Kinumpirma ni Liza ang buod ng sarili niyang sinabi, hindi ang attendance o bagong appointment.

## [observe] Direktang ebidensya

Iniuugnay ang bawat ulat sa pinagmulan, inihihiwalay ang direktang nakita sa hula, tapat na minamarkahan ang kulang, pumipili lamang ng kaugnay na detalye at tumutukoy ng angkop na beripikasyon.

Kaya na: Iniuugnay ang bawat ulat sa pinagmulan, inihihiwalay ang direktang nakita sa hula, tapat na minamarkahan ang kulang, pumipili lamang ng kaugnay na detalye at tumutukoy ng angkop na beripikasyon. Nagagawa nang mag-isa at naitatala ang pinagmulan ng pagwawasto.
Kailangan pang magsanay: May pagtatangka; naihihiwalay ang ilang detalye ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa pinagmulan, kawalan ng katiyakan, kaugnayan o beripikasyon. Ulitin ang bahaging iyon.
Hindi pa: Walang naobserbahang pagtatangka, o itinatala pa rin ang hula/opinyon bilang katotohanan kahit may tulong. Kung hindi nasaksihan, markahang hindi naobserbahan at magtakda ng direktang obserbasyon.

Facilitator sampling: triads 1–3 sa round 1, 4–6 sa round 2, 7–10 sa round 3. Itala ang pangalan ng role/attempt na aktuwal na nasaksihan at eksaktong salita/kilos. Hindi nito nasasaklaw ang lahat ng 30 BHW attempts. Markahang hindi naobserbahan ang iba at magtakda ng direktang follow-up. Isang indicator lamang, objective_index: 0. Ang completion at kuwento ay hindi competence o certification.

## [support] Suporta at pag-ulit

Walang internet/projector: gumamit ng printed cards at basahing demonstration. Mag-isa: paper sorting, attributed note at verification plan; ayusin ang susunod na direktang obserbasyon. Reading/language/accessibility: basahin nang malakas, dictation, malaking print o gustong wika; pareho ang pamantayan. Huwag pilitin ang eye contact o personal disclosure. Sa may prompt, pumili ng isang napansing gap, magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ulitin. Itala kung may tulong o independent sa bagong attempt; huwag palitan ang hindi naobserbahan ng hula. Ang agarang tulong ay hindi maantala ng routine interview.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at review

DOH BHW Reference Manual PDF 18–19 (communication passage, hindi self-management) at 30; Facilitator Guide PDF 28 / printed 21; Day 1 deck slides 52–57. TESDA BHS NC II Rev.01, promulgated 11 January 2019, PDF 26–28 / printed 22–24, unit 400311215: scope, confidentiality, validity at recording. Hindi sinasabing ito lamang ang pinakabagong edition. NPC IRR sections 18, 19 at 34: transparency, proportionality, accuracy, retention at correction rights. Ang ordinaryong pahintulot sa pag-uusap ay hindi ipinapakitang tanging legal basis ng lahat ng processing. Ang dialogue, sorting aid, triad/timing at note ay authored adaptations, hindi opisyal na universal form. Pending ang human source, local purpose/access/correction/retention at SME signoff. Walang diagnosis, dose, bagong emergency number o pangakong serbisyo. Detalyadong recipients/delivery ay nasa 1.6.5.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

From conflicting accounts, produce a record separating reports, observations and unconfirmed details, with a way to verify the gap.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

90 minutes of facilitated practice: 10 opening + 15 demonstration + 30 three triad rounds + 20 correction/verification + 10 debrief + 5 exit check = 90. Five lessons allocate 90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90 = 480 minutes; the shared module outline is another view of this same program, not an extra eight hours. Paper, pens, bilingual role cards, observer checklist and recording aid. No actual resident records. Authored independent estimate: 11–14 minutes, using the longer language track. Actual six-screen narration is 400.61 seconds in English and 446.30 seconds in Filipino; allow 3–6 minutes for the check, brief rehearsal and reflection. Optional story or replay is additional.

## [prepare] Prepare

For 30 participants, form ten triads numbered 1–10. Print four A4 pages per language: BHW, resident, observer with checklist, and recording aid. Show the picture before the check; withhold its ending and correct answer. Prepare source cards A–F. Have the authorized local custodian review purpose, access, correction and retention procedure before real use. Until then, use this as fictional rehearsal only; do not invent policy.

## [opening] Opening · 10 minutes

Ask: “When no card is shown, what did we directly observe? What do we still not know?” Expected: no card was shown in the conversation; this does not establish no appointment or nonattendance. Introduce Gibs, Liza and the four columns. Nobody must disclose personal experience. Distinguish information from diagnosis, judgment or investigation.

## [steps] Demonstration and sequence

15 minutes: read sources and relevant-detail. As Gibs: “This is for an authorized household profile. Only relevant information will be used by the authorized health team under local policy. May we clarify?” As Liza: “The schedule was canceled.” Gibs: “What do you mean by canceled?” Liza: “I could not go when my sister was away. I am not sure whether the center canceled it.” Gibs: “You could not go when your sister was away; the status is uncertain. Is that right?” Liza: “Yes.” Show the incorrect note and attributed correction from verify-gap. Say: “This confirms the summary of the report, not attendance.” This dialogue is fictional adaptation, not a DOH quotation. Continue with 30 minutes of triad rounds, 20 minutes of revision/verification, 10 minutes of debrief and a 5-minute exit check.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

A and E: Liza reports. B: neighbor reports; opinion about interest, not verified motive. C: direct observation only. D: unconfirmed. F: irrelevant, exclude it. Liza’s clarification is an attributed reported correction. Suitable verification: the relevant attendance record with the authorized midwife under the access procedure. The actual date is not expected because it is absent from the cards.

## [misconception] Common errors

Turning “reports” into fact; assuming no card means nonattendance; choosing the loudest voice; writing a diagnosis or “liar”; guessing a date; including gossip; treating a nod as proof of everything; erasing the correction’s source. Ask: “Which card is your evidence? Is it reported or observed? What remains uncertain?” Do not turn peer feedback into a grade.

## [practice] Practice and debrief

30 minutes: three ten-minute rounds (5 attempt + 3 feedback + 2 retry). A/B/C roles: BHW/resident/observer → observer/BHW/resident → resident/observer/BHW. Everyone attempts the BHW role. The neighbor is a printed source card, not a fourth actor. 20 minutes: review and correct the note, underline sources and write one suitable verification step. 10 debrief: “What changed after clarification? What is still uncertain? Why exclude F? What did Liza confirm and what did she not?” Expected: attributed correction; date/status still uncertain; debt is irrelevant; only her summary is confirmed. 5 exit check: choose, explain and compare with the practice note.

## [answer-key] Check answer key

2. “Liza reports a canceled schedule; date to be verified in the record.”

First: even with “according to the neighbor,” “not interested” is a judgment about motive, not an established fact. Second: the report is clearly attributed to Liza and identifies a gap for verification; this is the appropriate initial note. Third: one report does not establish that every appointment was canceled. In the ending, Liza clarifies that she could not attend when her sister was away and is unsure whether the center canceled it. Corrected note: Liza first reported cancellation; she clarified the barrier and uncertainty. No card was shown. Date/status remain unconfirmed; ask the authorized midwife to check the relevant record under the local access procedure. Liza confirms the summary of her own report, not attendance or a new appointment.

## [observe] Direct evidence

Attributes each report, separates direct observation from inference, marks the gap honestly, selects only relevant details and names a suitable verification step.

Ready: Attributes each report, separates direct observation from inference, marks the gap honestly, selects only relevant details and names a suitable verification step. Performs independently and retains the correction’s source.
Needs practice: Attempts the task and separates some details but needs prompts for attribution, uncertainty, relevance or verification. Repeat that part.
Not yet: No attempt is observed, or guesses/opinions are still recorded as fact despite support. If not witnessed, mark not observed and arrange direct observation.

Facilitator sampling: triads 1–3 in round 1, 4–6 in round 2, 7–10 in round 3. Record the role/attempt actually witnessed and exact words/actions. This does not cover all 30 BHW attempts. Mark other attempts not observed and arrange direct follow-up. One indicator only, objective_index: 0. Completion and story viewing are not competence or certification.

## [support] Support and retry

No internet/projector: use printed cards and a read-aloud demonstration. Solo: paper sorting, attributed note and verification plan; arrange later direct observation. Reading/language/accessibility: read aloud, dictation, large print or preferred language; keep the same standard. Do not force eye contact or personal disclosure. For prompted work, choose one observed gap, give specific feedback and retry. Record support or independence in the new attempt; never replace not observed with a guess. Immediate help is not delayed by a routine interview.

## [sources-review] Sources and review

DOH BHW Reference Manual PDF 18–19 (communication passage, separate from self-management) and 30; Facilitator Guide PDF 28 / printed 21; Day 1 deck slides 52–57. TESDA BHS NC II Rev.01, promulgated 11 January 2019, PDF 26–28 / printed 22–24, unit 400311215: scope, confidentiality, validity and recording. No claim that this is independently confirmed as the latest edition. NPC IRR sections 18, 19 and 34: transparency, proportionality, accuracy, retention and correction rights. Ordinary conversation permission is not presented as the sole legal basis for all processing. Dialogue, sorting aid, triads/timing and notes are authored adaptations, not an official universal form. Human source, local purpose/access/correction/retention and SME signoff are pending. No diagnosis, dose, invented emergency number or promised service. Detailed recipients/delivery belong to 1.6.5.

read_sections.body_en:
Gibs, a male BHW, listens to Liza, 29. “It is hard to go when nobody can look after my child,” Liza says. “Your concern matters. If you want, we can ask the midwife about scheduling,” Gibs replies. He promises neither an appointment nor childcare.

Give one step in plain words: “First we will ask the midwife when she can be contacted.” Then ask: “To check that I explained clearly, how would you describe the next step in your own words?”

“Do I have an appointment tomorrow?” Liza asks. “Not yet. My explanation was unclear,” Gibs replies. “We will ask about scheduling first; there is no confirmed appointment. What will we do first?” “Ask about the schedule; I am not booked yet,” Liza says. “Yes, that is the first step,” Gibs confirms.

Teach-back checks the BHW’s explanation, not the person’s intelligence or memory. Explain, ask, repair the misunderstanding, and check again. Use a helpful picture and the person’s preferred language; stay within approved messages and the BHW role.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Gibs, lalaking BHW, ay nakikinig kay Liza, 29. “Mahirap pumunta kapag walang magbabantay sa anak ko,” sabi ni Liza. “Mahalaga ang alalahanin mo. Kung gusto mo, maaari nating alamin ang iskedyul sa midwife,” tugon ni Gibs. Hindi niya ipinapangako ang appointment o childcare.

Isang hakbang muna, gamit ang payak na salita: “Magtatanong muna tayo sa midwife kung kailan siya maaaring makausap.” Saka: “Para malaman kong malinaw ang paliwanag ko, paano mo ikukuwento ang susunod na hakbang sa sarili mong salita?”

“May appointment na ako bukas?” tanong ni Liza. “Hindi pa. Hindi malinaw ang paliwanag ko,” sagot ni Gibs. “Magtatanong muna tayo tungkol sa iskedyul; wala pang kumpirmadong appointment. Ano muna ang gagawin natin?” “Magtatanong tungkol sa iskedyul; hindi pa ako naka-book,” sabi ni Liza. “Tama, iyon muna,” tugon ni Gibs.

Ang teach-back ay check sa paliwanag ng BHW, hindi pagsusulit sa talino o memorya ng kausap. Magpaliwanag, magtanong, ayusin ang hindi malinaw, at mag-check muli. Gumamit ng angkop na larawan at wikang komportable ang kausap; manatili sa aprubadong mensahe at saklaw ng BHW.

Jo, 24, is worried about something she heard about family planning. “What specifically worries you?” Gibs asks. He listens without mocking her belief. “I do not want someone choosing for me,” Jo says. “You decide; you can raise your concern with a qualified provider,” Gibs replies.

Use only general information from approved materials and your own training. Choosing an appropriate method and clinical counseling are discussions between Jo and a midwife or qualified provider. Gibs does not select a method or prescribe. He does not pressure Jo to decide or disclose private details.

In this fictional rehearsal, the contact’s name and hours are unknown. “If you want, I will ask the health team for the appropriate contact and how to request a private conversation. The schedule is not confirmed. To check that I explained clearly, what is the first step?” “Find out the contact first; not choose a method now,” Jo replies.

Before an actual visit, verify the contact, BHW role and arrangements for a private conversation with the local health team. Explain approved information use and who needs to receive it under local policy. Do not promise absolute secrecy.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Jo, 24, ay may takot sa narinig tungkol sa family planning. “Ano ang partikular na ikinababahala mo?” tanong ni Gibs. Nakikinig siya nang hindi pinagtatawanan ang paniniwala. “Ayokong may pumili para sa akin,” sabi ni Jo. “Ikaw ang magpapasya; puwede mong itanong ang concern sa kwalipikadong provider,” tugon ni Gibs.

Gamitin lamang ang pangkalahatang impormasyon mula sa aprubadong materyal at sariling pagsasanay. Ang pagpili ng angkop na paraan at klinikal na counseling ay usapan ni Jo at ng midwife o kwalipikadong provider. Hindi pipili o magrereseta si Gibs. Hindi niya pipilitin si Jo na magpasya o magsabi ng pribadong detalye.

Sa kathang-isip na pagsasanay, hindi pa alam ang oras o pangalan ng contact. “Kung gusto mo, aalamin ko sa health team ang tamang contact at kung paano humingi ng pribadong usapan. Hindi pa kumpirmado ang iskedyul. Para malaman kong malinaw ako, ano muna ang hakbang?” “Alamin muna ang contact; hindi pumili ng paraan ngayon,” sagot ni Jo.

Bago gamitin sa tunay na pagbisita, tiyakin sa lokal na health team ang aktuwal na contact, saklaw ng BHW at paraan ng pribadong usapan. Ipaliwanag ang aprubadong gamit ng impormasyon at sino lamang ang kailangang makatanggap nito ayon sa lokal na patakaran. Walang pangakong ganap na lihim.

Ben, 37, says he has felt low for several weeks. Gibs might ask, “Thank you for telling me. What feels hardest right now?” Ben may choose not to share details. Ask whether the setting is comfortable; do not infer a diagnosis from silence, posture or looking away.

“I want someone to talk to, but I do not know who,” Ben says. “I can listen. If you want, I can help identify a qualified health professional through the local health team,” Gibs replies. He does not say “just think happy thoughts,” diagnose, or choose treatment.

In rehearsal, the contact’s name and availability are unknown. “I do not have a confirmed time yet. How do you understand our first step?” “Find out the contact first; this is not an appointment yet,” Ben replies. If the meaning differs, explain another way and ask again.

In a real immediate danger to safety, seek help at once according to verified local emergency procedures; do not delay for an ordinary interview or report. Do not invent a number or a universal protocol. Do not promise to conceal danger from people who need to help.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Ben, 37, ay nagsasabing ilang linggo na siyang malungkot. “Salamat sa pagsabi. Ano ang pinakamabigat para sa iyo ngayon?” ang maaaring itanong ni Gibs. Maaari ring piliin ni Ben na huwag ikuwento ang detalye. Tanungin kung komportable ang lugar; huwag maghinuha ng diagnosis sa katahimikan, postura o pag-iwas ng tingin.

“Gusto kong may makausap, pero hindi ko alam kung sino,” sabi ni Ben. “Makikinig ako. Kung gusto mo, tutulong akong alamin ang kwalipikadong health professional sa lokal na health team,” tugon ni Gibs. Hindi niya sasabihing “isipin mo lang ang masasaya,” magbibigay ng diagnosis, o pipili ng paggamot.

Sa pagsasanay, hindi pa alam ang pangalan at availability ng contact. “Wala pa akong kumpirmadong oras. Ano muna ang pagkaunawa mo sa hakbang natin?” “Aalamin muna ang contact; hindi pa ito appointment,” sagot ni Ben. Kung iba ang pagkaunawa, magpaliwanag sa ibang paraan at itanong muli.

Sa tunay na agarang panganib sa kaligtasan, humingi kaagad ng tulong ayon sa natiyak na lokal na emergency procedure; huwag ipagpaliban dahil sa ordinaryong interview o report. Walang imbentong numero o iisang protocol para sa lahat. Huwag mangakong ililihim ang panganib sa mga taong kailangang tumulong.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Listen and identify a qualified contact. In immediate danger, do not delay help for an ordinary interview.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig at alamin ang kwalipikadong contact. Sa agarang panganib, huwag antalahin ang tulong para sa ordinaryong interview.

read_sections.body_en:
Ramon, 45, feels attacked when called “undisciplined.” “May we discuss smoking and the support you want?” Gibs asks. If Ramon does not want to discuss it now, respect his answer. “I want to cut down, but it is hard when I am stressed,” Ramon says.

“You want a change, and stress is a barrier. Is that right?” Gibs checks. Listen to the answer. Offer only a step within the BHW role: ask the local health team about a qualified contact and support actually available. Neither a service nor a time is confirmed in this fictional situation.

“If you want, we can first find out who you could speak with. To check that I explained clearly, what will we do first?” “Will you give me medicine?” Ramon asks. “I will not give or choose medicine. We will identify the contact so you can ask a qualified provider. How would you describe the first step?” “Find out the contact; medication is a discussion with the provider,” Ramon replies.

No lecture, medication, dose or promised outcome. Before an actual conversation, verify available local support and authorized messages; do not invent a service.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Ramon, 45, ay napipikon kapag tinatawag na “walang disiplina.” “Puwede ba nating pag-usapan ang paninigarilyo at ang suportang gusto mo?” tanong ni Gibs. Kung ayaw muna ni Ramon, igalang ang sagot. “Gusto kong mabawasan, pero mahirap kapag stress,” sabi ni Ramon.

“Gusto mong may mabago, at hadlang ang stress. Tama ba?” paglilinaw ni Gibs. Pakinggan ang sagot. slides.narration_en:

Give one step in plain words: “First we will ask the midwife when she can be contacted.” Then ask: “To check that I explained clearly, how would you describe the next step in your own words?”

“Do I have an appointment tomorrow?” Liza asks. “Not yet. My explanation was unclear,” Gibs replies. “We will ask about scheduling first; there is no confirmed appointment. What will we do first?” “Ask about the schedule; I am not booked yet,” Liza says. “Yes, that is the first step,” Gibs confirms.

Teach-back checks the BHW’s explanation, not the person’s intelligence or memory. Explain, ask, repair the misunderstanding, and check again. Use a helpful picture and the person’s preferred language; stay within approved messages and the BHW role.

“May appointment na ako bukas?” tanong ni Liza. “Hindi pa. Hindi malinaw ang paliwanag ko,” sagot ni Gibs. “Magtatanong muna tayo tungkol sa iskedyul; wala pang kumpirmadong appointment. slides.narration_en:

Use only general information from approved materials and your own training. Choosing an appropriate method and clinical counseling are discussions between Jo and a midwife or qualified provider. Gibs does not select a method or prescribe. He does not pressure Jo to decide or disclose private details.

In this fictional rehearsal, the contact’s name and hours are unknown. “If you want, I will ask the health team for the appropriate contact and how to request a private conversation. The schedule is not confirmed. To check that I explained clearly, what is the first step?” “Find out the contact first; not choose a method now,” Jo replies.

Before an actual visit, verify the contact, BHW role and arrangements for a private conversation with the local health team. Explain approved information use and who needs to receive it under local policy. Do not promise absolute secrecy.

Si Jo, 24, ay may takot sa narinig tungkol sa family planning. “Ano ang partikular na ikinababahala mo?” tanong ni Gibs. Gamitin lamang ang pangkalahatang impormasyon mula sa aprubadong materyal at sariling pagsasanay. Ang pagpili ng angkop na paraan at klinikal na counseling ay usapan ni Jo at ng midwife o kwalipikadong provider. Hindi pipili o magrereseta si Gibs. Hindi niya pipilitin si Jo na magpasya o magsabi ng pribadong detalye.

Sa kathang-isip na pagsasanay, hindi pa alam ang oras o pangalan ng contact. “Kung gusto mo, aalamin ko sa health team ang tamang contact at kung paano humingi ng pribadong usapan. Hindi pa kumpirmado ang iskedyul. Para malaman kong malinaw ako, ano muna ang hakbang?” “Alamin muna ang contact; hindi pumili ng paraan ngayon,” sagot ni Jo.

Bago gamitin sa tunay na pagbisita, tiyakin sa lokal na health team ang aktuwal na contact, saklaw ng BHW at paraan ng pribadong usapan. Ipaliwanag ang aprubadong gamit ng impormasyon at sino lamang ang kailangang makatanggap nito ayon sa lokal na patakaran. Walang pangakong ganap na lihim.

slides.narration_en:
Ben, 37, says he has felt low for several weeks. Gibs might ask, “Thank you for telling me. What feels hardest right now?” Ben may choose not to share details. Ask whether the setting is comfortable; do not infer a diagnosis from silence, posture or looking away.

“I want someone to talk to, but I do not know who,” Ben says. “I can listen. If you want, I can help identify a qualified health professional through the local health team,” Gibs replies. He does not say “just think happy thoughts,” diagnose, or choose treatment.

In rehearsal, the contact’s name and availability are unknown. “I do not have a confirmed time yet. How do you understand our first step?” “Find out the contact first; this is not an appointment yet,” Ben replies. If the meaning differs, explain another way and ask again.

In a real immediate danger to safety, seek help at once according to verified local emergency procedures; do not delay for an ordinary interview or report. Do not invent a number or a universal protocol. Do not promise to conceal danger from people who need to help.

Sa tunay na agarang panganib sa kaligtasan, humingi kaagad ng tulong ayon sa natiyak na lokal na emergency procedure; huwag ipagpaliban dahil sa ordinaryong interview o report. ## [purpose] Layunin

Sa isang sensitibong usapan, kilalanin ang concern, magbigay ng isang hakbang na saklaw ng BHW at ipasabi ito sa sariling salita ng kausap. Ipakita ang repair at recheck; huwag magbigay ng diagnosis o paggamot.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

120 guided minutes: 10 pambungad + 20 demonstration + 45 tatlong round + 25 repair/recheck + 15 debrief + 5 exit check = 120. Ang 90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90 = 480 minuto ay iisang pinagsamang programa; ang shared module outline ay ibang pagtingin sa parehong oras. Hindi dagdag na walong oras.

30 kalahok sa sampung triad. Papel, panulat, bilingual role cards, observer checklist at one-page task aid. Walang tunay na rekord. Opsyonal ang projector at internet.

Ginawang pagtataya ng sariling pag-aaral: 13–16 minuto, ayon sa mas mahabang salaysay. Aktuwal na salaysay ng anim na screen: 529.66 segundo sa English at 584.93 segundo sa Filipino; maglaan ng 3–6 minuto para sa check, maikling pagsasanay at pagninilay. Dagdag pa ang opsyonal na kuwento o pag-ulit.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Bago ituro, tiyakin sa lokal na health team ang awtorisadong impormasyon, contact para sa family planning, distress at smoking support, oras, paraan ng pribadong usapan at emergency procedure. Suriin ang aprubadong gamit at akses sa impormasyon ayon sa lokal na patakaran at NPC transparency, legitimate purpose at proportionality. Human/SME review ay pending. Kung hindi pa natiyak, gamitin lamang ang kathang-isip na card at sabihin na hindi pa kumpirmado; huwag gumawa ng referral promise.

Ihanda ang sampung triad at pag-ikot ng papel. Sabihin na walang sapilitang personal na disclosure, eye contact o upload; maaaring pribadong pares o solo. Walang real resident names.

## [opening] Pambungad · 10 minuto

Itanong: “Kapag tumango ang kausap, alam na ba nating malinaw ang paliwanag? Ano pa ang puwedeng itanong?” Tanggapin ang iba’t ibang dahilan ng pagtango; huwag hulaan ang talino o damdamin. Sabihin: “Check ito sa paliwanag natin. Maaari mong baguhin ang paraan ng paglahok at gumamit ng komportableng wika.”

## [steps] Demonstration · 20 minuto

Basahin ang buong teach-back screen bilang Gibs at Liza. Ipakita ang maling pagkaunawang “May appointment na ako bukas?” Huminto: “Ano ang sinabi ni Gibs na hindi malinaw?” Ipakita ang repair: “Hindi pa. Magtatanong muna sa midwife tungkol sa iskedyul.” Saka itanong muli: “Ano muna ang gagawin natin?” Ang residenteng sagot ay “Magtatanong tungkol sa iskedyul; hindi pa naka-book.”

Itanong: “Sino ang may pananagutan sa linaw? Aling salita ang naglinaw ng hindi pa kumpirmado?” Ipakita ang proseso sa larawan. Huwag ipakita ang check feedback bago pumili ang kalahok.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang BHW ang nag-aayos ng sariling paliwanag; hindi pinapahiya ang kausap. Iisang hakbang muna, payak na salita at tanong sa sariling paliwanag. Sa Jo/Ben/Ramon cards, alamin muna sa health team ang kwalipikadong contact; hindi garantiya ng appointment, paraan o gamot. Tamang pagtatapos: sariling paliwanag ng residente, supportive correction kung kailangan, at recheck. Puwedeng tumanggi sa usapan o detalye.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

“Naintindihan mo?” at pagtango lang: ipamodel ang “Para malaman kong malinaw ako, paano mo sasabihin ang unang hakbang?” Mabilis na pag-uulit: gumamit ng ibang payak na salita. Sermon o pagsisi: kilalanin ang concern. Diagnosis mula sa katahimikan: magtanong tungkol sa komportableng lugar, huwag maghinuha. Pangakong service/appointment: sabihin ang hindi pa kumpirmado. Walang gamot, dose, forced disclosure o ganap na secrecy. Huwag antalahin ang agarang tulong para sa ordinaryong interview/report.

## [practice] Tatlong round · 45 minuto; repair · 25 minuto

Round 1, 15 minuto: Jo. Round 2, 15 minuto: Ben. Round 3, 15 minuto: Ramon. Sa bawat round, 3 minuto sa pagbasa ng cards, 5 usapan, 3 observer feedback at 4 repair/recheck. Iikot ang papel A/B/C: BHW/residente/tagamasid → tagamasid/BHW/residente → residente/tagamasid/BHW. Lahat ay BHW minsan.

Pagkatapos, 25 minuto: pumili ng isang hindi malinaw na paliwanag; ulitin sa pares o solo, kasama ang repair, sariling sagot at recheck. Obserbahan ang mga naka-iskedyul na retry; huwag magbigay ng grade mula sa peer report.

Debrief, 15 minuto: “Anong concern ang kinilala? Anong hakbang ang saklaw ng BHW? Ano ang hindi pa alam? Aling tanong ang naglabas ng maling pagkaunawa? Paano mo inayos at muling sinuri?” Walang personal na karanasan na kailangang ibahagi.

## [answer-key] Exit check · 5 minuto

Ipakita ang unresolved check scene, ipapili ang sagot at ipasabi ang dahilan. Tama ang index 2 / ikatlong sagot.

Una: Ang pagsisi at pagtatapos ay hindi nag-aayos ng hindi malinaw na mensahe at maaaring magpatahimik kay Liza. Ikalawa: Ang parehong paliwanag nang mas mabilis ay hindi tumutugon sa maling pagkaunawa. Ikatlo: Ang ibang paraan ng paliwanag at pag-check muli ay angkop; si Gibs ang may pananagutan sa linaw. Sa wakas, sabi ni Gibs, “Hindi pa appointment. Magtatanong muna tayo tungkol sa iskedyul. Ano muna ang gagawin natin?” Sagot ni Liza, “Magtatanong tungkol sa iskedyul; wala pang kumpirmadong appointment.” “Tama, iyon muna,” tugon ni Gibs.

Ipasabi ang repaired next step sa sariling salita. Ang check/completion at panonood ay hindi certification.

## [observe] Direktang obserbasyon

Kinikilala ang concern nang walang paninisi; nagbibigay ng isang tamang hakbang sa saklaw ng BHW; nagtatanong ng sariling paliwanag; inaayos ang maling pagkaunawa at muling sinusuri; sinasabi ang hindi pa kumpirmado.

Facilitator sampling: triads 1–3 sa round 1, 4–6 sa round 2, 7–10 sa round 3. Direct sampling ng triad ay hindi katumbas ng pag-obserba sa lahat ng tatlong BHW attempts. Itala ang eksaktong learner attempt na nakita. Markahan ang iba na hindi naobserbahan at mag-iskedyul ng later direct observation. Peer feedback ay practice, hindi facilitator grade.

Kaya na: Kinikilala ang concern nang walang paninisi; nagbibigay ng isang tamang hakbang sa saklaw ng BHW; nagtatanong ng sariling paliwanag; inaayos ang maling pagkaunawa at muling sinusuri; sinasabi ang hindi pa kumpirmado. Nagagawa nang walang prompt sa direktang naobserbahang pagtatangka.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Angkop ang hakbang ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa teach-back, repair o recheck; halimbawa, pagtango lamang ang unang check. Itala ang tulong at ipaulit nang malaya.

Hindi pa: Walang direktang ebidensiya ng pagtatangka, o nagbibigay ng diagnosis, paggamot o garantiyang serbisyo, o inaantala ang agarang tulong. Itala ang eksaktong kulang o hindi ligtas; ipamodel at ipaulit.

Sa checklist, itala ang concern, isang hakbang, sariling paliwanag, repair at recheck bilang nagawa / may prompt / hindi pa / hindi naobserbahan. Huwag mag-upload ng personal na detalye.

## [support] Accessibility at retry

Maaaring magsalita, magsulat, magpatulong magbasa o gumamit ng komportableng wika. Mag-alok ng tahimik na pares o solo gamit ang parehong fictional cards; walang internet/projector. Hindi kailangang umarte o tumingin sa mata. Sa solo, isulat ang magkabilang panig at repair/recheck, saka ipakita sa facilitator.

Sa supported attempt, ipamodel ang kulang na hakbang, bigyan ng bagong kathang-isip na misunderstanding at ipa-demonstrate nang malaya. Itala ang bagong direktang ebidensiya; huwag awtomatikong palitan ang hindi naobserbahan ng kaya na.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at review

DOH BHW Reference Manual PDF 18 communication passage (hiwalay sa self-management), 19 at 30; Facilitator Guide PDF 28 / printed 21; Day 1 slides 52–57. AHRQ Tool 5: https://www.ahrq.gov/health-literacy/improve/precautions/tool5.html — teach-back bilang authored instructional addition. NPC IRR: transparency, legitimate purpose at proportionality. TESDA Rev.01, 11 January 2019, unit 400311215: simulated/direct individual observation; huwag ipahayag na natiyak ang kawalan ng mas bagong edition.

## [purpose] Purpose

In a sensitive conversation, acknowledge the concern, give one next step within the BHW role and ask the person to explain it in their own words. Demonstrate repair and recheck; do not diagnose or treat.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

120 guided minutes: 10 opening + 20 demonstration + 45 three rounds + 25 repair/recheck + 15 debrief + 5 exit check = 120. The 90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90 = 480 minutes form one combined program; the shared module outline is another view of the same time, not an additional eight hours.

30 participants in ten triads. Paper, pens, bilingual role cards, observer checklist and one-page task aid. No real records. Projector and internet are optional.

Authored independent estimate: 13–16 minutes, using the longer language track. Actual six-screen narration is 529.66 seconds in English and 584.93 seconds in Filipino; allow 3–6 minutes for the check, brief rehearsal and reflection. Optional story or replay is additional.

## [prepare] Prepare

Before delivery, verify authorized information, contacts for family planning, distress and smoking support, hours, private conversation arrangements and emergency procedures with the local health team. Review approved information use and access under local policy and NPC transparency, legitimate purpose and proportionality. Human/SME review is pending. Until verified, use only fictional cards, state what is unconfirmed and make no referral promise.

Prepare ten triads and role rotation. Explain that no personal disclosure, eye contact or upload is required; a private pair or solo alternative is available. No real resident names.

## [opening] Opening · 10 minutes

Ask: “Does a nod tell us our explanation was clear? What else could we ask?” Accept different reasons for nodding; do not guess intelligence or feelings. Say: “We are checking our explanation. You may change how you participate and use your preferred language.”

## [steps] Demonstration · 20 minutes

Read the entire teach-back screen as Gibs and Liza. Show the misunderstanding, “Do I have an appointment tomorrow?” Pause: “What was unclear in Gibs’s explanation?” Model the repair: “Not yet. First we will ask the midwife about scheduling.” Then ask again: “What will we do first?” The resident replies, “Ask about the schedule; I am not booked yet.”

Ask: “Who is responsible for clarity? Which phrase clarifies what is unconfirmed?” Show the illustrated sequence. Do not reveal check feedback before a learner chooses.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The BHW repairs the explanation without shaming the person. Give one step in plain words and ask for an explanation in their own words. In the Jo/Ben/Ramon cards, first ask the health team about a qualified contact; this guarantees no appointment, method or medication. End with the resident’s own explanation, a supportive correction when needed and recheck. People may decline discussion or details.

## [misconception] Common errors

“Do you understand?” and a nod alone: model “To check that I explained clearly, how would you describe the first step?” Faster repetition: use different plain words. A lecture or blame: acknowledge the concern. Diagnosis from silence: ask about a comfortable setting, do not infer. A service/appointment promise: state what is unconfirmed. No medication, dose, forced disclosure or absolute secrecy. Do not delay urgent help for an ordinary interview/report.

## [practice] Three rounds · 45 minutes; repair · 25 minutes

Round 1, 15 minutes: Jo. Round 2, 15 minutes: Ben. Round 3, 15 minutes: Ramon. Each round: 3 minutes reading cards, 5 conversation, 3 observer feedback and 4 repair/recheck. Rotate roles A/B/C: BHW/resident/observer → observer/BHW/resident → resident/observer/BHW. Everyone plays BHW once.

Then 25 minutes: choose a confusing explanation; repeat in pairs or alone, including repair, the person’s own answer and recheck. Observe scheduled retries; do not grade from a peer report.

Debrief, 15 minutes: “Which concern was acknowledged? Which step is within the BHW role? What remains unknown? Which question revealed misunderstanding? How did you repair and check again?” No personal experience needs to be disclosed.

## [answer-key] Exit check · 5 minutes

Show the unresolved check scene, ask learners to choose and explain why. Correct index 2 / third option.

First: Blame and ending the conversation do not repair an unclear message and may silence Liza. Second: The same explanation delivered faster does not address the misunderstanding. Third: Explaining another way and checking again is appropriate; Gibs takes responsibility for clarity. In the ending, Gibs says, “This is not an appointment yet. We will ask about scheduling first. What will we do first?” Liza replies, “Ask about the schedule; there is no confirmed appointment.” “Yes, that is the first step,” Gibs confirms.

Ask for the repaired next step in their own words. Check/completion and viewing do not establish certification.

## [observe] Direct observation

Acknowledges the concern without blame; gives one correct step within the BHW role; invites an explanation in the person’s own words; repairs misunderstanding and checks again; states what is unconfirmed.

Facilitator sampling: triads 1–3 in round 1, 4–6 in round 2, 7–10 in round 3. Sampling a triad does not observe all three learners’ BHW attempts. Record the specific learner attempt actually seen. Mark others not observed and schedule later direct observation. Peer feedback is practice, not a facilitator grade.

Ready: Acknowledges the concern without blame; gives one correct step within the BHW role; invites an explanation in the person’s own words; repairs misunderstanding and checks again; states what is unconfirmed. Performs without prompting in a directly observed attempt.

Needs practice: The step is appropriate but teach-back, repair or recheck needs prompting; for example, initially checks only for a nod. Record support and arrange an independent retry.

Not yet: No direct evidence of an attempt, or gives a diagnosis, treatment or guaranteed service, or delays immediate help. Record the missing or unsafe action; model and retry.

On the checklist record concern, one step, own explanation, repair and recheck as done / prompted / not yet / not observed. Do not upload personal details.

## [support] Accessibility and retry

Allow speech, writing, reading assistance or a preferred language. Offer a quiet pair or solo using the same fictional cards; no internet/projector. Acting and eye contact are optional. Alone, write both sides and repair/recheck, then demonstrate to the facilitator.

For a supported attempt, model the missing step, provide a new fictional misunderstanding and ask for an independent demonstration. Record fresh direct evidence; never automatically convert not observed into ready.

## [sources-review] Sources and review

TESDA Rev.01, 11 January 2019, unit 400311215: simulated/direct individual observation; do not claim confirmation that no newer edition exists.

objectives_en: Using the four criteria, calculate and explain the example ranking and state why it does not replace urgent referral.

read_sections.body_en: For planning, score each problem from 1 to 5 on four criteria: how many are affected, severity of the effects, feasibility with available resources, and urgency. A higher feasibility score means more achievable. Add the four scores and discuss their evidence with the group. A high total suggests a starting priority, not permission to ignore serious danger. Refer someone needing urgent care immediately rather than waiting for a planning score.
read_sections.body_fil: Sa pagpaplano, bigyan ang bawat problema ng 1–5 sa apat na batayan: laki o dami ng apektado, kabigatan ng epekto, kakayahang malutas gamit ang resources, at pagkamadalian. Mas mataas na feasibility score ang mas kayang tugunan. Pagsamahin ang apat na marka at ipaliwanag ang batayan kasama ang grupo. Ang mataas na kabuuan ay panimulang prayoridad, hindi utos na balewalain ang malubhang panganib. Ang nangangailangan ng agarang pangangalaga ay i-refer agad; hindi hinihintay ang planning score.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Priorities require explicit criteria and local judgment; they do not replace immediate referral.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang prayoridad ay may malinaw na batayan at lokal na paghatol; hindi nito pinapalitan ang agarang referral.

read_sections.body_en: Fictional practice: a BHW training gap scores 4 + 5 + 5 + 5 = 19; a safe-water teaching gap scores 4 + 3 + 5 + 5 = 17; a household water-preparation knowledge gap scores 3 + 3 + 5 + 5 = 16. The order is magnitude, severity, feasibility, urgency. These are the deck’s example scores, not measurements of your barangay. Name the evidence needed before using each score in a real plan.

Ang ayos ay laki, kabigatan, feasibility, urgency. Ito ang scores sa halimbawang deck, hindi sukat ng inyong barangay. Ibigay ang ebidensyang kailangan bago gamitin ang bawat marka sa totoong plano.

45 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 3 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Iguhit ang apat na column at tatlong row sa papel. Ipakita ang halimbawa bilang practice data lamang.

## [opening] Pambungad

Parehong 17 ang dalawang problema. Alin ang gagawin ng grupo?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang unang sagot ay may batayan at bukas sa grupo. Ang pagkakasunod sa listahan at kagustuhan ng lider ay hindi dagdag na ebidensya. Kung may nangangailangan ng agarang pangangalaga, sundin agad ang referral protocol.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Mali ang direksyon ng feasibility o itinuturing na pahintulot ang ranking na ipagpaliban ang agarang pangangalaga. Ang total ay gabay sa pagpaplano; kailangan pa rin ang ebidensya, pag-uusap at agarang referral kapag kailangan.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Kopyahin ang tatlong halimbawang row at kwentahin ang total. Ipaliwanag kung bakit 19 ang una, saka maglista ng ebidensyang kailangan bago gamitin ang score sa inyong lugar. Magkunwaring tabla ang dalawang problema: talakayin ang urgency at resources. Kung mag-isa, isulat ang paliwanag. Sa susunod na planning meeting, itanong kung saan galing ang mga score.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

1. Balikan ang ebidensya, urgency at resources bago magkasundo.

Ang unang sagot ay may batayan at bukas sa grupo. Ang pagkakasunod sa listahan at kagustuhan ng lider ay hindi dagdag na ebidensya. Kung may nangangailangan ng agarang pangangalaga, sundin agad ang referral protocol.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Tama ang tatlong total; naipapaliwanag ang apat na pamantayan at direksyon ng feasibility; humihingi ng lokal na ebidensya at hindi ipinagpapaliban ang urgent care.

Kaya na: Tama ang tatlong total; naipapaliwanag ang apat na pamantayan at direksyon ng feasibility; humihingi ng lokal na ebidensya at hindi ipinagpapaliban ang urgent care. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Tama ang pamantayan ngunit may mali sa pagdaragdag; gumamit ng row-by-row na tally at ipaulit.

Hindi pa: Mali ang direksyon ng feasibility o itinuturing na pahintulot ang ranking na ipagpaliban ang agarang pangangalaga.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Tama ang pamantayan ngunit may mali sa pagdaragdag; gumamit ng row-by-row na tally at ipaulit. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 29; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 19, 20, 21. Ang source table ay larawan; minana ang beripikadong interpretasyon ng naunang implementation plan. Ang Rosario case ay hiwalay na ZFF source. Hindi clinical advice ang kasaysayan. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Using the four criteria, calculate and explain the example ranking and state why it does not replace urgent referral.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

45 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 3 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Draw four columns and three rows on paper. Label the example as practice data only.

## [opening] Opening

Two problems both score 17. What should the group do?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The first response is evidence-based and open to the group. List order and a leader’s preference are not additional evidence. Follow referral procedures immediately for someone needing urgent care.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Reverses feasibility or treats ranking as permission to delay urgent care. Totals guide planning; evidence, discussion and urgent referral when needed still matter.

## [practice] Practice activity

Copy the three example rows and calculate totals. Explain why 19 ranks first, then list evidence needed before using those scores locally. Simulate a tie: discuss urgency and resources. Alone, write the explanation. At the next planning meeting, ask where the scores came from.

## [answer-key] Answer key

1. Revisit evidence, urgency and resources before agreeing.

The first response is evidence-based and open to the group. List order and a leader’s preference are not additional evidence. Follow referral procedures immediately for someone needing urgent care.

## [observe] Observe

Calculates all three totals correctly, explains the four criteria and feasibility direction, requests local evidence and does not delay urgent care.

Ready: Calculates all three totals correctly, explains the four criteria and feasibility direction, requests local evidence and does not delay urgent care. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Uses the right criteria but makes an addition error; use a row-by-row tally and repeat.

Not yet: Reverses feasibility or treats ranking as permission to delay urgent care.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Uses the right criteria but makes an addition error; use a row-by-row tally and repeat. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 29; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 19, 20, 21. The source table is an image; this draft inherits the earlier implementation plan’s verified interpretation. Rosario is a separate ZFF case source. The historical account is not clinical advice. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

read_sections.body_en:
Gibs is the fictional male BHW; Liza, 29, is the resident. Her earlier attributed record says attending the health center is difficult because she has no one to watch her child. Her last attendance date remains unverified. This is neither a diagnosis nor evidence that she refuses to attend.

In a private conversation with the authorized midwife, Gibs says: “Liza reports difficulty finding childcare. Her last attendance date is not yet verified. She requests a conversation about scheduling. Could you check a possible way for her to talk with you?”

Use the locally approved form if available: date, relevant concern, source, uncertainty, action taken and requested action. Record the request separately from what was actually agreed. Asking for help does not approve a visit, appointment or childcare. This dialogue is an authored teaching example, not a DOH quotation.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Gibs ang kathang-isip na lalaking BHW; si Liza, 29, ang residente. Sa naunang tala, sinabi ni Liza na mahirap pumunta sa health center dahil walang magbabantay sa anak. Hindi pa natiyak ang petsa ng huling pagpunta. Hindi ito diagnosis o patunay na ayaw niyang pumunta.

Sa pribadong usapan sa awtorisadong midwife, sinabi ni Gibs: “Ayon kay Liza, hirap siyang makahanap ng magbabantay sa anak. Hindi pa natiyak ang huling pagpunta niya. Humihingi siya ng pakikipag-usap tungkol sa iskedyul. Maaari po ba ninyong tingnan ang posibleng paraan ng pakikipag-usap?”

Gamitin ang lokal na aprubadong form kung mayroon: petsa, kaugnay na concern, pinagmulan, hindi pa tiyak, ginawa at hinihinging aksyon. Itala nang magkahiwalay ang hiling at ang talagang napagkasunduan. Ang paghingi ng tulong ay hindi pa pag-apruba ng pagbisita, appointment o childcare. Ang usapang ito ay ginawang halimbawa para sa aralin, hindi sipi mula sa DOH.
