read_sections.takeaway_en: Separate the concern, source and missing detail; a request is not yet an agreement.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ihiwalay ang concern, pinagmulan at kulang na detalye; ang hinihingi ay hindi pa napagkasunduan.

read_sections.body_en:
Before sending, verify who is authorized to receive an individual report and what they need for their role. In this example, the midwife is the designated recipient. Every meeting participant is not automatically authorized to receive a private case.

Gibs asks: “Are you the authorized recipient for this report? Which approved method should we use?” Verify the actual recipient; do not rely only on an account name. Follow the verified local procedure for a spoken, paper or electronic handoff. A personal phone is not automatically approved. Keep names and personal forms out of public group chats.

Explain the purpose, recipient and next step to Liza in plain language under local policy. Give the midwife only relevant details. At a meeting, use sufficient aggregated information that cannot identify a household. Do not promise absolute secrecy in every situation. If urgent assistance is needed, do not delay help to finish a routine report; follow the verified local process.
read_sections.body_fil:
Bago magpadala, tiyakin kung sino ang awtorisadong tumanggap ng indibidwal na ulat at ano ang kailangan niya para sa kanyang tungkulin. Sa halimbawa, ang midwife ang itinalagang tatanggap. Hindi nangangahulugang maaaring tumanggap ng pribadong kaso ang bawat kasama sa pulong.

Sinabi ni Gibs: “Kayo po ba ang awtorisadong tatanggap nito? Aling aprubadong paraan ang gagamitin natin?” Tiyakin ang aktuwal na tatanggap; huwag umasa sa pangalan lang sa isang account. Sundin ang natiyak na lokal na paraan para sa pasalita, papel o elektronikong ulat. Hindi awtomatikong aprubado ang personal na telepono. Huwag ilagay ang pangalan o personal na form sa pampublikong group chat.

Kay Liza, ipaliwanag sa payak na wika ang layunin, tatanggap at susunod na hakbang ayon sa lokal na patakaran. Sa midwife, ibigay lamang ang kaugnay na detalye. Sa pulong, gumamit ng sapat na pinagsama-samang impormasyon na hindi makakakilala sa isang pamilya. Walang pangakong lubos na lihim sa lahat ng pagkakataon. Kung may agarang pangangailangan, huwag ipagpaliban ang tulong para tapusin ang karaniwang ulat; sundin ang natiyak na lokal na proseso.
read_sections.heading_en: The right recipient and enough detail
read_sections.takeaway_en: Verify the authorized recipient and locally approved method; share only what is needed.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyakin ang awtorisadong tatanggap at lokal na aprubadong paraan; ibahagi lamang ang kailangan.

read_sections.body_en:
In this practice exercise, three fictional households report childcare barriers. The barangay planning meeting aims to discuss scheduling, not expose their private stories. Names, form photographs, exact addresses and details that point to a household are unnecessary. Combined details can identify someone even without a name.

Gibs gives a brief report: “In three fictional reports, childcare was mentioned as a barrier. Not all attendance dates have been verified. Could we discuss how to explain scheduling options?” This is a coordination question, not a statement that a change is approved. The count belongs only to this example; it is not barangay data.

Keep individual follow-up separate from the meeting. In real work, use only authorized information for the approved purpose under local procedure. If removing identifying details is insufficient, do not share the case with the group; ask the designated health team member for the appropriate method.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa pagsasanay, tatlong kathang-isip na pamilya ang nagsabing hadlang ang magbabantay sa anak. Ang layunin ng barangay planning meeting ay pag-usapan ang iskedyul, hindi ilantad ang kanilang personal na kuwento. Walang kailangang pangalan, larawan ng form, eksaktong tirahan o detalyeng madaling magturo sa isang pamilya. Kahit walang pangalan, maaaring makilala ang tao mula sa pinagsamang detalye.

Maikling ulat ni Gibs: “Sa tatlong kathang-isip na ulat, nabanggit ang hadlang sa pagbabantay ng anak. Hindi pa natiyak ang lahat ng petsa ng pagpunta. Maaari bang pag-usapan kung paano ipapaliwanag ang mga pagpipilian sa iskedyul?” Tanong ito para sa koordinasyon, hindi pahayag na aprubado na ang pagbabago. Ang bilang ay mula lamang sa halimbawang ito, hindi datos ng barangay.

Ihiwalay ang indibidwal na follow-up sa pulong. Sa tunay na gawain, gamitin lamang ang awtorisadong impormasyon para sa aprubadong layunin at lokal na proseso. Kung hindi sapat ang pagtatanggal ng pagkakakilanlan, huwag ibahagi ang kaso sa grupo; itanong ang tamang paraan sa itinalagang health team member.
read_sections.heading_en: A pattern for the meeting, a case for the right person
read_sections.heading_fil: Pattern sa pulong, kaso sa tamang tao
read_sections.takeaway_en: At a meeting, give a sufficient pattern and a clear question; private cases go to the authorized recipient.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Sa pulong, sapat na pattern at malinaw na tanong; ang pribadong kaso ay sa awtorisadong tatanggap.

read_sections.body_en:
A sent message does not prove that it was read, understood or agreed to. Ask the recipient and listen to clarification. In this example, the midwife asks: “Is the last attendance date certain?” Gibs replies: “Not yet. I will correct the report: Liza is the source of the barrier; the date still needs verification.”

The midwife says: “I received your report. I will check scheduling options and talk with you tomorrow through our agreed private method.” Gibs repeats: “You will check the schedule. Tomorrow I will confirm your response with you, then explain the verified next step to Liza. Is that correct?” The midwife agrees. This is the agreement in the fictional exercise, not a universal local deadline.

Record acknowledgement, who will act, what they will do and when or how to confirm again. Do not tell Liza that an appointment or childcare is arranged when it is not. If the recipient cannot be reached, follow only the verified local backup process; do not invent a substitute recipient or an emergency rule.
read_sections.body_fil:
Ang naipadalang mensahe ay hindi patunay na nabasa, naunawaan o napagkasunduan ang hiling. Tanungin ang tatanggap at pakinggan ang paglilinaw. Sa halimbawa, nagtanong ang midwife: “Tiyak ba ang huling petsa?” Sumagot si Gibs: “Hindi pa po. Itatama ko ang ulat: ayon kay Liza ang hadlang; ang petsa ay kailangan pang beripikahin.”

Sinabi ng midwife: “Natanggap ko ang ulat. Titingnan ko ang mga pagpipilian sa iskedyul at kakausapin kita bukas sa napagkasunduan nating pribadong paraan.” Inulit ni Gibs: “Kayo po ang titingin sa iskedyul. Bukas ko kukumpirmahin sa inyo ang sagot; pagkatapos ay ipapaliwanag ko kay Liza ang natiyak na hakbang. Tama po ba?” Sumang-ayon ang midwife. Ito ang napagkasunduan sa kathang-isip na pagsasanay, hindi pangkalahatang deadline sa lahat ng lugar.

Itala ang pagtanggap, sino ang gagawa, ano ang gagawin at kailan o paano muling kukumpirmahin. Huwag sabihin kay Liza na may appointment o childcare na kung wala pa. Kung hindi makontak ang tatanggap, sundin lamang ang natiyak na lokal na backup process; huwag gumawa ng sariling kapalit na tatanggap o emergency rule.

read_sections.heading_fil: Natanggap ba, at ano ang napagkasunduan?
read_sections.takeaway_en: Confirm receipt and the agreement: who, what, and when or how to follow up.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang pagtanggap at ang napagkasunduan: sino, ano, at kailan o paano mag-follow-up.

read_sections.body_en:
In a triad, use fictional role cards. First, play Gibs and give the brief report: concern, source and uncertainty, request and secure method. Second, play the authorized midwife: ask one clarification, acknowledge receipt and agree on an action within the role. Third, observe with the checklist. Rotate roles over three rounds so everyone practises giving the report.

Replace “The family is difficult” with Liza’s honestly attributed concern and the verified or unverified details. After clarification, repeat who will do what and when or how to follow up. Include no diagnosis, promised service or real resident record. Give specific feedback, then retry the missing part. Peer feedback is not a facilitator grade.

Alone or without internet, write or say the report using paper cards. Read the midwife’s clarification and prepare the reply and confirmation. Reading support or the preferred language may be used. Keep the same standard; arrange later direct facilitator observation before claiming that the performance was observed.
read_sections.body_fil:
Sa grupo ng tatlo, gumamit ng kathang-isip na role cards. Una, gumanap na Gibs at ibigay ang maikling ulat: concern, pinagmulan at hindi pa tiyak, hiling at ligtas na paraan. Ikalawa, gumanap na awtorisadong midwife: humingi ng isang paglilinaw, kilalanin ang pagtanggap at makipagkasundo sa kayang gawin. Ikatlo, magmasid gamit ang checklist. Iikot ang mga tungkulin sa tatlong round upang lahat ay makapag-ulat.

Palitan ang “Mahirap kausap ang pamilya” ng tapat na concern ni Liza at kung alin ang natiyak o hindi pa natiyak. Pagkatapos ng paglilinaw, ulitin kung sino ang gagawa ng ano at kailan o paano susundan. Walang diagnosis, pangakong serbisyo o tunay na resident record. Magbigay ng tiyak na puna, saka ulitin ang bahaging kulang. Ang puna ng kapareha ay hindi marka ng facilitator.

Kung mag-isa o walang internet, isulat o sabihin ang ulat gamit ang papel na cards. Basahin ang paglilinaw ng midwife at buuin ang sagot at kumpirmasyon. Maaaring may katuwang sa pagbasa o sariling wika. Pareho ang pamantayan; ang direktang obserbasyon ng facilitator ay kailangang maisagawa sa kalaunan bago sabihing naobserbahan ang kakayahan.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Practise reporting, answering clarification and confirming; retry the missing part.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Magsanay sa pag-uulat, pagsagot sa paglilinaw at pagkumpirma; ulitin ang bahaging kulang.

check.prompt_en: A barangay meeting asks about missed visits. What should be shared?
check.prompt_fil: Humihingi ang barangay meeting ng paliwanag sa missed visits. Ano ang ibabahagi?
check.feedback_en: First: The aggregated childcare barrier and scheduling question are sufficient for planning if no details identify a household. Second: Photographs of household forms expose unnecessary private details; the group does not need them. Third: Names and a neighbor’s opinion are inappropriate; an opinion is not evidence of the cause. In the ending, the chair acknowledges the aggregated summary and agrees to ask the designated health team member how to clarify scheduling at the next coordination meeting. Gibs confirms who will act and how to obtain the response. Separately, he confirms that the authorized midwife received the individual report and checks their follow-up agreement. No appointment or childcare is promised.
check.feedback_fil: Una: Ang pinagsamang childcare barrier at tanong tungkol sa iskedyul ay sapat para sa pagpaplano, kung walang detalyeng makakakilala sa pamilya. Ikalawa: Ang larawan ng household forms ay naglalantad ng hindi kailangang pribadong detalye; hindi iyon ang kailangan ng grupo. Ikatlo: Ang pangalan at opinyon ng kapitbahay ay hindi angkop; ang opinyon ay hindi ebidensya ng dahilan. Sa wakas, tinanggap ng chair ang pinagsamang buod at napagkasunduang itanong niya sa itinalagang health team member ang paraan ng paglilinaw sa iskedyul sa susunod na coordination meeting. Kinumpirma ni Gibs kung sino ang gagawa at paano kukunin ang sagot. Hiwalay niyang kinumpirma sa awtorisadong midwife ang pagtanggap ng indibidwal na ulat at kanilang follow-up. Walang ipinangakong appointment o childcare.

Bago magpadala, tiyakin kung sino ang awtorisadong tumanggap ng indibidwal na ulat at ano ang kailangan niya para sa kanyang tungkulin. Sa halimbawa, ang midwife ang itinalagang tatanggap. Hindi nangangahulugang maaaring tumanggap ng pribadong kaso ang bawat kasama sa pulong.

Sinabi ni Gibs: “Kayo po ba ang awtorisadong tatanggap nito? Aling aprubadong paraan ang gagamitin natin?” Tiyakin ang aktuwal na tatanggap; huwag umasa sa pangalan lang sa isang account. Sundin ang natiyak na lokal na paraan para sa pasalita, papel o elektronikong ulat. Hindi awtomatikong aprubado ang personal na telepono. Huwag ilagay ang pangalan o personal na form sa pampublikong group chat.

Kay Liza, ipaliwanag sa payak na wika ang layunin, tatanggap at susunod na hakbang ayon sa lokal na patakaran. Sa midwife, ibigay lamang ang kaugnay na detalye. Sa pulong, gumamit ng sapat na pinagsama-samang impormasyon na hindi makakakilala sa isang pamilya. Walang pangakong lubos na lihim sa lahat ng pagkakataon. Kung may agarang pangangailangan, huwag ipagpaliban ang tulong para tapusin ang karaniwang ulat; sundin ang natiyak na lokal na proseso.

slides.display_en: At a meeting, give a sufficient pattern and a clear question; private cases go to the authorized recipient.
slides.heading_en: A pattern for the meeting, a case for the right person
slides.display_fil: Sa pulong, sapat na pattern at malinaw na tanong; ang pribadong kaso ay sa awtorisadong tatanggap.
slides.heading_fil: Pattern sa pulong, kaso sa tamang tao
slides.narration_en:
In this practice exercise, three fictional households report childcare barriers. The barangay planning meeting aims to discuss scheduling, not expose their private stories. Names, form photographs, exact addresses and details that point to a household are unnecessary. Combined details can identify someone even without a name.

Gibs gives a brief report: “In three fictional reports, childcare was mentioned as a barrier. Not all attendance dates have been verified. Could we discuss how to explain scheduling options?” This is a coordination question, not a statement that a change is approved. The count belongs only to this example; it is not barangay data.

Keep individual follow-up separate from the meeting. In real work, use only authorized information for the approved purpose under local procedure. If removing identifying details is insufficient, do not share the case with the group; ask the designated health team member for the appropriate method.
slides.narration_fil:
Sa pagsasanay, tatlong kathang-isip na pamilya ang nagsabing hadlang ang magbabantay sa anak. Ang layunin ng barangay planning meeting ay pag-usapan ang iskedyul, hindi ilantad ang kanilang personal na kuwento. Walang kailangang pangalan, larawan ng form, eksaktong tirahan o detalyeng madaling magturo sa isang pamilya. Kahit walang pangalan, maaaring makilala ang tao mula sa pinagsamang detalye.

Maikling ulat ni Gibs: “Sa tatlong kathang-isip na ulat, nabanggit ang hadlang sa pagbabantay ng anak. Hindi pa natiyak ang lahat ng petsa ng pagpunta. Maaari bang pag-usapan kung paano ipapaliwanag ang mga pagpipilian sa iskedyul?” Tanong ito para sa koordinasyon, hindi pahayag na aprubado na ang pagbabago. Ang bilang ay mula lamang sa halimbawang ito, hindi datos ng barangay.

Ihiwalay ang indibidwal na follow-up sa pulong. Sa tunay na gawain, gamitin lamang ang awtorisadong impormasyon para sa aprubadong layunin at lokal na proseso. Kung hindi sapat ang pagtatanggal ng pagkakakilanlan, huwag ibahagi ang kaso sa grupo; itanong ang tamang paraan sa itinalagang health team member.

slides.display_en: Confirm receipt and the agreement: who, what, and when or how to follow up.
slides.heading_en: Was it received, and what was agreed?
slides.display_fil: Kumpirmahin ang pagtanggap at ang napagkasunduan: sino, ano, at kailan o paano mag-follow-up.
slides.heading_fil: Natanggap ba, at ano ang napagkasunduan?
slides.narration_en:
A sent message does not prove that it was read, understood or agreed to. Ask the recipient and listen to clarification. In this example, the midwife asks: “Is the last attendance date certain?” Gibs replies: “Not yet. I will correct the report: Liza is the source of the barrier; the date still needs verification.”

The midwife says: “I received your report. I will check scheduling options and talk with you tomorrow through our agreed private method.” Gibs repeats: “You will check the schedule. Tomorrow I will confirm your response with you, then explain the verified next step to Liza. Is that correct?” The midwife agrees. This is the agreement in the fictional exercise, not a universal local deadline.

Record acknowledgement, who will act, what they will do and when or how to confirm again. Do not tell Liza that an appointment or childcare is arranged when it is not. If the recipient cannot be reached, follow only the verified local backup process; do not invent a substitute recipient or an emergency rule.
slides.narration_fil:
Ang naipadalang mensahe ay hindi patunay na nabasa, naunawaan o napagkasunduan ang hiling. Tanungin ang tatanggap at pakinggan ang paglilinaw. Sa halimbawa, nagtanong ang midwife: “Tiyak ba ang huling petsa?” Sumagot si Gibs: “Hindi pa po. Itatama ko ang ulat: ayon kay Liza ang hadlang; ang petsa ay kailangan pang beripikahin.”

Sinabi ng midwife: “Natanggap ko ang ulat. Titingnan ko ang mga pagpipilian sa iskedyul at kakausapin kita bukas sa napagkasunduan nating pribadong paraan.” Inulit ni Gibs: “Kayo po ang titingin sa iskedyul. Bukas ko kukumpirmahin sa inyo ang sagot; pagkatapos ay ipapaliwanag ko kay Liza ang natiyak na hakbang. Tama po ba?” Sumang-ayon ang midwife. Ito ang napagkasunduan sa kathang-isip na pagsasanay, hindi pangkalahatang deadline sa lahat ng lugar.

Itala ang pagtanggap, sino ang gagawa, ano ang gagawin at kailan o paano muling kukumpirmahin. Huwag sabihin kay Liza na may appointment o childcare na kung wala pa. Kung hindi makontak ang tatanggap, sundin lamang ang natiyak na lokal na backup process; huwag gumawa ng sariling kapalit na tatanggap o emergency rule.

slides.display_en: Practise reporting, answering clarification and confirming; retry the missing part.
slides.display_fil: Magsanay sa pag-uulat, pagsagot sa paglilinaw at pagkumpirma; ulitin ang bahaging kulang.
slides.narration_en:
In a triad, use fictional role cards. First, play Gibs and give the brief report: concern, source and uncertainty, request and secure method. Second, play the authorized midwife: ask one clarification, acknowledge receipt and agree on an action within the role. Third, observe with the checklist. Rotate roles over three rounds so everyone practises giving the report.

Replace “The family is difficult” with Liza’s honestly attributed concern and the verified or unverified details. After clarification, repeat who will do what and when or how to follow up. Include no diagnosis, promised service or real resident record. Give specific feedback, then retry the missing part. Peer feedback is not a facilitator grade.

Alone or without internet, write or say the report using paper cards. Read the midwife’s clarification and prepare the reply and confirmation. Reading support or the preferred language may be used. Keep the same standard; arrange later direct facilitator observation before claiming that the performance was observed.
slides.narration_fil:
Sa grupo ng tatlo, gumamit ng kathang-isip na role cards. Una, gumanap na Gibs at ibigay ang maikling ulat: concern, pinagmulan at hindi pa tiyak, hiling at ligtas na paraan. Ikalawa, gumanap na awtorisadong midwife: humingi ng isang paglilinaw, kilalanin ang pagtanggap at makipagkasundo sa kayang gawin. Ikatlo, magmasid gamit ang checklist. Iikot ang mga tungkulin sa tatlong round upang lahat ay makapag-ulat.

Palitan ang “Mahirap kausap ang pamilya” ng tapat na concern ni Liza at kung alin ang natiyak o hindi pa natiyak. Pagkatapos ng paglilinaw, ulitin kung sino ang gagawa ng ano at kailan o paano susundan. Walang diagnosis, pangakong serbisyo o tunay na resident record. Magbigay ng tiyak na puna, saka ulitin ang bahaging kulang. Ang puna ng kapareha ay hindi marka ng facilitator.

Kung mag-isa o walang internet, isulat o sabihin ang ulat gamit ang papel na cards. Basahin ang paglilinaw ng midwife at buuin ang sagot at kumpirmasyon. Maaaring may katuwang sa pagbasa o sariling wika. Pareho ang pamantayan; ang direktang obserbasyon ng facilitator ay kailangang maisagawa sa kalaunan bago sabihing naobserbahan ang kakayahan.

check.feedback_en: First: The aggregated childcare barrier and scheduling question are sufficient for planning if no details identify a household. Second: Photographs of household forms expose unnecessary private details; the group does not need them. Third: Names and a neighbor’s opinion are inappropriate; an opinion is not evidence of the cause. In the ending, the chair acknowledges the aggregated summary and agrees to ask the designated health team member how to clarify scheduling at the next coordination meeting. Gibs confirms who will act and how to obtain the response. Separately, he confirms that the authorized midwife received the individual report and checks their follow-up agreement. No appointment or childcare is promised.
check.feedback_fil: Una: Ang pinagsamang childcare barrier at tanong tungkol sa iskedyul ay sapat para sa pagpaplano, kung walang detalyeng makakakilala sa pamilya. Ikalawa: Ang larawan ng household forms ay naglalantad ng hindi kailangang pribadong detalye; hindi iyon ang kailangan ng grupo. Ikatlo: Ang pangalan at opinyon ng kapitbahay ay hindi angkop; ang opinyon ay hindi ebidensya ng dahilan. Sa wakas, tinanggap ng chair ang pinagsamang buod at napagkasunduang itanong niya sa itinalagang health team member ang paraan ng paglilinaw sa iskedyul sa susunod na coordination meeting. Kinumpirma ni Gibs kung sino ang gagawa at paano kukunin ang sagot. Hiwalay niyang kinumpirma sa awtorisadong midwife ang pagtanggap ng indibidwal na ulat at kanilang follow-up. The chair of a barangay planning meeting asks about missed visits. Gibs has a private record from the fictional exercise, but not everyone present is authorized to receive individual cases. A schedule change has not been approved.

Look at the situation before choosing. What relevant information does the group need for planning? Choose an answer and explain why. After selecting, read all three rationales and the ending, then compare them with your own report and confirmation.
slides.narration_fil:
Nagtanong ang chair ng barangay planning meeting tungkol sa mga hindi natuloy na pagpunta. May pribadong tala si Gibs mula sa kathang-isip na pagsasanay, ngunit hindi lahat ng nasa pulong ay awtorisadong tumanggap ng indibidwal na kaso. Hindi pa aprubado ang pagbabago sa iskedyul.

Tingnan ang larawan ng sitwasyon bago pumili. Ano ang kaugnay na impormasyong kailangan ng grupo para magplano? Piliin ang sagot at ipaliwanag kung bakit. Pagkatapos pumili, basahin ang paliwanag sa lahat ng pagpipilian at ang wakas; ihambing sa sariling ulat at kumpirmasyon.

private_notes.notes_fil:
## [purpose] Layunin

Gumawa ng maikling ulat para sa midwife na may concern, pinagmulan at hindi pa tiyak na detalye, hinihinging aksyon at ligtas na paraan ng pagpapadala.

Ang ebidensya ay ligtas na ulat na may pinagmulan, paglilinaw, pagtanggap at napagkasunduang hakbang. Ang pagtatapos ng aralin, puna ng kapareha at panonood ng opsyonal na kuwento ay hindi pagtatasa ng kakayahan.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

90 guided minutes: 10 pambungad + 15 demonstrasyon + 30 tatlong round ng triads + 20 pag-ulit ng ulat/pagtanggap + 10 debrief + 5 exit check. Ang 90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90 = 480 ay iisang pinagsamang programa; ang balangkas ng module ay paglalarawan ng parehong 480 minuto.

30 kalahok sa sampung triads. Ilimbag ang tatlong role cards, checklist ng observer at isang pahinang gabay bawat grupo; papel, panulat at folder na walang laman. Walang tunay na resident record o upload. Hiwalay na Read/audio time: Ginawang pagtataya ng sariling pag-aaral: 12–15 minuto, ayon sa mas mahabang salaysay. Aktuwal na salaysay ng anim na screen: 459.02 segundo sa English at 522.84 segundo sa Filipino; maglaan ng 3–6 minuto para sa check, maikling pagsasanay at pagninilay. Dagdag pa ang opsyonal na kuwento o pag-ulit.

## [prepare] Paghahanda

Tiyakin sa responsableng health team ang lokal na aprubadong form, layunin, awtorisadong tatanggap, ligtas na paraan ng pagpapadala/pagtatago, backup process at agarang tulong. Itala ang nakabinbing policy/SME review; huwag magpalagay ng personal-device approval, pangkalahatang channel o referral threshold. Kung wala pa, gamitin lamang ang malinaw na kathang-isip na harapang paraan sa pagsasanay; hindi nito inaaprubahan ang tunay na proseso.

Bumuo ng sampung triads, bilang 1–10. Ipakita ang rubric. Payagan ang sariling wika at suporta sa pagbasa/accessibility; walang sapilitang personal na pagsisiwalat. Ihiwalay ang direktang obserbasyon sa simpleng paglahok.

## [opening] Pambungad · 10 minuto

Itanong: “Ano ang maaaring gamitin ng planning meeting nang hindi tumatanggap ng pribadong household form?” Dalawang minuto sa pag-iisip/pagsulat, apat sa pag-uusap, apat sa paghahambing ng hiling at kumpirmadong kasunduan. Kathang-isip na halimbawa lamang. Huwag munang ipakita ang sagot sa check.

## [steps] Demonstrasyon · 15 minuto

Ipakita ang handoff, audience at confirm-next-step dialogue na nasa Read. Isang volunteer ang itinalagang midwife. Itanong: “Alin ang ayon kay Liza? Aling petsa ang hindi pa tiyak? Ano ang hiniling ni Gibs? Ano ang talagang napagkasunduan?” Huminto bago ang pagtanggap at humingi ng isang paglilinaw. Itama ang hindi tiyak na petsa; ulitin ang gagawa/aksyon/oras o paraan.

Sa halimbawa, titingnan ng midwife ang iskedyul at makikipag-usap nang pribado bukas; kukumpirmahin ni Gibs ang sagot at ipapaliwanag lamang ang natiyak kay Liza. Walang pangakong appointment, childcare, diagnosis o paggamot. Ihambing ang pribadong ulat sa sapat na pinagsamang buod sa pulong. Ang dialogue, oras at kasunduang bukas ay ginawang halimbawa, hindi opisyal na tuntunin.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Pinagmulan: sariling sabi ni Liza na mahirap makahanap ng magbabantay sa anak. Hindi pa tiyak: huling petsa ng pagpunta at aktuwal na appointment/childcare. Hiling: usapan tungkol sa iskedyul. Kasunduan: titingnan ng midwife ang pagpipilian; kukumpirmahin ni Gibs bukas sa napagkasunduang pribadong paraan, saka ipapaliwanag ang natiyak. Ang “sent” ay hindi patunay ng pagtanggap o kasunduan.

Sa planning group: angkop na buod na walang pagkakakilanlan at tanong sa iskedyul; hindi personal na form, pangalan o opinyon ng kapitbahay. Maaaring makilala ang tao kahit inalis ang pangalan.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

“Mahirap kausap” na walang pinagmulan; hindi tiyak na petsang ginawang tiyak; pangakong appointment o childcare; palagay na lahat ng nasa pulong ay awtorisado; pagpapadala ng record sa public chat o hindi natiyak na account; “sent” na itinuring na “received”; follow-up na walang gagawa; puna ng peer na ginawang marka. Hingin ang eksaktong itatamang pangungusap o kilos, saka ulitin. Huwag ipagpaliban ang agarang tulong para tapusin ang karaniwang ulat.

## [practice] Pagsasanay at pag-ulit · 50 minuto

30 minuto sa triads: tatlong round na tig-sampu. Bawat round: dalawang minuto sa cards, tatlo sa ulat/paglilinaw/kumpirmasyon, tatlo sa tiyak na puna ng observer, dalawa sa pag-ulit at pag-ikot. BHW → midwife → observer upang lahat ay makapag-ulat.

Direktang obserbahan ng facilitator ang triads 1–3 sa round one, 4–6 sa round two, 7–10 sa round three. Ang BHW na aktuwal na nakita lamang ang itatala; hindi ibig sabihin naobserbahan lahat ng 30 kalahok. Markahan ang iba na “hindi naobserbahan” at mag-ayos ng direktang obserbasyon sa kalaunan. Puna ng peer ay para sa practice.

20 minuto sa pag-ulit: lima sa pagpili ng kulang, sampu sa ulat na may bagong paglilinaw, lima sa pag-check ng itinama. Obserbahan ang dagdag na kalahok ayon sa oras, walang pangkalahatang claim. Gamitin ang papel/solo cards kung kailangan.

## [answer-key] Check at debrief · 15 minuto

Una: Ang pinagsamang childcare barrier at tanong tungkol sa iskedyul ay sapat para sa pagpaplano, kung walang detalyeng makakakilala sa pamilya. Ikalawa: Ang larawan ng household forms ay naglalantad ng hindi kailangang pribadong detalye; hindi iyon ang kailangan ng grupo. Ikatlo: Ang pangalan at opinyon ng kapitbahay ay hindi angkop; ang opinyon ay hindi ebidensya ng dahilan. Sa wakas, tinanggap ng chair ang pinagsamang buod at napagkasunduang itanong niya sa itinalagang health team member ang paraan ng paglilinaw sa iskedyul sa susunod na coordination meeting. Kinumpirma ni Gibs kung sino ang gagawa at paano kukunin ang sagot. Hiwalay niyang kinumpirma sa awtorisadong midwife ang pagtanggap ng indibidwal na ulat at kanilang follow-up. Walang ipinangakong appointment o childcare.

10 minutong debrief: “Ano ang kaibahan ng hiling at kasunduan?” “Paano mo tapat na itinama ang hindi tiyak?” “Ano kung hindi makontak ang tatanggap?” Inaasahang backup answer: sundin lamang ang natiyak na lokal na proseso. Limang minutong exit check: ipakita ang hindi pa nalulutas na larawan at tatlong pagpipilian, hingin ang sagot at paliwanag, saka ipakita ang lahat ng rationale at wakas. Maaaring pasalita o pasulat.

## [observe] Direktang obserbasyon

Tinutukoy ang awtorisadong tatanggap; malinaw ang concern, pinagmulan at hindi pa tiyak; humihingi ng aksyon sa loob ng tungkulin ng BHW; pinipili ang natiyak na ligtas na paraan; kinukumpirma ang pagtanggap at kung sino ang gagawa ng ano at kailan o paano susundan.

Kaya na: Tinutukoy ang awtorisadong tatanggap; malinaw ang concern, pinagmulan at hindi pa tiyak; humihingi ng aksyon sa loob ng tungkulin ng BHW; pinipili ang natiyak na ligtas na paraan; kinukumpirma ang pagtanggap at kung sino ang gagawa ng ano at kailan o paano susundan. Nagagawa nang walang paalala; itinatama nang tapat ang kulang na detalye.

Kailangan ng practice: Nagbibigay ng kaugnay na ulat sa tulong ng prompt ngunit kulang ang pinagmulan, ligtas na paraan o may-ari at oras/paraan ng follow-up. Ulitin ang kulang na bahagi bago muling obserbahan.

Hindi pa: Walang direktang ebidensya pa, o naglalantad ng pribadong form, nag-iimbento ng katiyakan o pangakong serbisyo; hindi naipapakita ang ligtas na ulat at kumpirmasyon.

Itala ang eksaktong salita/kilos, petsa, tulong at aktuwal na naobserbahang bahagi. Ihiwalay ang “hindi naobserbahan” sa hindi matagumpay na subok. Muling obserbahan matapos ang suportadong rehearsal. Isang indicator sa objective_index 0; walang bagong tuntunin ng certification o scoring.

## [support] Suporta

Walang internet/projector: ilimbag ang cards, aid at sitwasyon; basahin ang dialogue. Mag-isa: bumuo ng ulat, gamitin ang midwife card sa paglilinaw, isulat o sabihin ang kumpirmasyon; mag-ayos ng direktang obserbasyon sa kalaunan. Payagan ang malaking print, tulong sa pagbasa, pahinga, pasalita/pasulat sa sariling wika. Walang sapilitang personal na kuwento o upload. Pareho ang pamantayan; tapat na itala ang suportang ibinigay.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at nakabinbing review

## [purpose] Purpose

Prepare a short handoff for the midwife containing the concern, sources and uncertainty, requested action and a secure delivery method.

Observable evidence is a secure, attributed handoff with clarification, acknowledged receipt and an agreed next step. Lesson completion, peer feedback and watching the optional story are not competency assessment.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

90 guided minutes: 10 opening + 15 demonstration + 30 three-round triads + 20 report/reception retry + 10 debrief + 5 exit check. The allocations 90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90 = 480 are one combined program; the shared module outline describes the same 480 minutes.

30 participants in ten triads. Print the three role cards, observer checklist and one-page task aid per triad; use paper, pens and an unmarked folder. No real resident records or uploads. Independent Read/audio time: Authored independent estimate: 12–15 minutes, using the longer language track. Actual six-screen narration is 459.02 seconds in English and 522.84 seconds in Filipino; allow 3–6 minutes for the check, brief rehearsal and reflection. Optional story or replay is additional.

## [prepare] Prepare

Verify the locally approved form, purpose, authorized recipient, secure communication method, storage, backup contact process and urgent-assistance procedure with the responsible health team. Record pending policy/SME review; do not fill gaps with assumed personal-device approval, a universal channel or a referral threshold. If unavailable, use only the explicit fictional face-to-face training method. This does not approve it for real work.

Arrange ten triads numbered 1–10. Share the rubric. Invite preferred language and reading/accessibility support without requiring personal disclosure. Keep each learner’s direct observation status distinct from role participation.

## [opening] Opening · 10 minutes

Ask: “What can a planning meeting use without receiving a private household form?” Give two minutes to think or write, four to discuss, four to compare a request with a confirmed agreement. Use fictional examples only. Do not reveal the check answer yet.

## [steps] Demonstration · 15 minutes

Model the handoff, audience and confirm-next-step dialogue exactly as in the Read screens. Use a volunteer as the designated midwife. Ask: “Which statement comes from Liza? Which date remains unknown? What did Gibs request? What did the midwife actually agree to do?” Pause before the acknowledgement and invite one clarification. Correct the date uncertainty, then repeat owner/action/time-or-method.

The fictional midwife agrees to check scheduling options and speak privately tomorrow; Gibs agrees to confirm the response and explain only verified information to Liza. Do not promise an appointment, childcare, diagnosis or treatment. Contrast this private report with the meeting’s minimal aggregated summary. Dialogue, timing and tomorrow’s agreement are authored adaptations, not official rules.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

Source: Liza’s own report of difficulty finding childcare. Unknown: last attendance date and available appointment/childcare arrangements. Request: a conversation about scheduling. Agreement: midwife checks options; Gibs confirms tomorrow through their agreed private method and then explains verified information. A sent message alone proves neither receipt nor agreement.

The planning group can discuss an appropriately de-identified pattern and a scheduling question; it does not need personal forms, names or a neighbor’s opinion. Removing names alone may not prevent identification.

## [misconception] Common errors

Unattributed “difficult family”; claiming an unverified date is certain; promising a booked visit or childcare; assuming everyone in the meeting is authorized; sending a record to a public chat or unverified account; treating “sent” as “received”; leaving follow-up without an owner; grading peers as facilitator observations. Ask for the exact corrected sentence or action, then retry it. Do not delay urgent help to finish a routine report.

## [practice] Practice and retry · 50 minutes

30-minute triads: three rounds of ten minutes, each with two minutes to read cards, three for the report/clarification/confirmation, three for specific observer feedback, and two to retry and rotate. Rotate BHW → midwife → observer so every participant gives a handoff.

Facilitator samples triads 1–3 in round one, 4–6 in round two and 7–10 in round three. Record only the observed BHW performance in each sampled triad; sampling all triads does not observe all 30 learners. Mark other performances “not observed” and arrange later direct observation. Peer notes remain practice evidence.

20-minute report/reception retry: five to choose one gap; ten to repeat the handoff including a new clarification; five to check the correction. Directly observe additional learners as time permits without claiming blanket coverage. Provide paper/solo versions from the cards when needed.

## [answer-key] Check and debrief · 15 minutes

First: The aggregated childcare barrier and scheduling question are sufficient for planning if no details identify a household. Second: Photographs of household forms expose unnecessary private details; the group does not need them. Third: Names and a neighbor’s opinion are inappropriate; an opinion is not evidence of the cause. In the ending, the chair acknowledges the aggregated summary and agrees to ask the designated health team member how to clarify scheduling at the next coordination meeting. Gibs confirms who will act and how to obtain the response. Separately, he confirms that the authorized midwife received the individual report and checks their follow-up agreement. No appointment or childcare is promised.

10-minute debrief prompts: “What is the difference between a request and an agreement?” “How did you correct an unknown honestly?” “What would you do if the intended recipient could not be reached?” Expected backup answer: follow only the verified local process. Five-minute exit check: present the unresolved picture and all three choices, ask for a selection and explanation, then reveal all three rationales and ending. Allow spoken or written responses.

## [observe] Direct observation

Identifies the authorized recipient; reports the concern, source and uncertainty clearly; requests action within the BHW role; selects a verified secure method; confirms receipt and who will do what and when or how to follow up.

Ready: Identifies the authorized recipient; reports the concern, source and uncertainty clearly; requests action within the BHW role; selects a verified secure method; confirms receipt and who will do what and when or how to follow up. Does this independently and honestly corrects missing details.

Needs practice: Gives a relevant report with prompts but omits a source, secure method or follow-up owner and time/method. Retry the missing part before another observation.

Not yet: No direct evidence yet, or exposes a private form, invents certainty or promises a service; does not demonstrate a secure handoff and confirmation.

Record exact words/actions, date, support given and the part actually observed. Distinguish “not observed” from a failed attempt. Re-observe after supported rehearsal. One indicator at objective_index 0; no new certification or scoring rule.

## [support] Access and support

Without internet/projector: print cards, aid and the dilemma; read the dialogue aloud. Alone: prepare a report, use the midwife card to answer the clarification, and write or say the confirmation; arrange later direct observation. Offer large print, reading assistance, breaks and spoken/written responses in the preferred language. Do not force a personal story or upload. Keep the same task standard and describe support honestly.

DOH Reference Manual PDF 18–19 (communication passage on 18 separately from self-management) and 30 (confidentiality/respect); DOH Facilitator Guide PDF 28 / printed 21 (gather/assess/record/present, household role-play, combined eight hours); Day 1 presentation 52–57. See lesson-165-source-audit.json for verified bytes and the claim crosswalk. NPC IRR sections 18–20 supports transparency, legitimate purpose and proportionality; lawful access and local secure/backup/urgent-help procedure require local policy review. TESDA Rev.01, 11 January 2019, unit 400311215 is an inspected edition; do not assert no later edition exists.

Fictional dialogue, cards, six screens, 90-minute triads and timing are authored adaptations. Pending: owner package/art review, human listening in both languages and local-policy/SME signoff. No publication approval inherited from lesson 1.6.1.

read_sections.body_en:
Nestor, 41, is investigating missed visits by three example households. He consults residents and health-center staff before recommending changes.

Ask why the visit was missed, then why the reported reason arose. In this fictional example, childcare was unavailable; the schedule overlapped work; only one time was communicated; household availability had not been checked. These are possible explanations to confirm with residents, BHWs and health-center staff. Reaching exactly five whys is not the goal. Reach an actionable cause supported by evidence; follow separate branches when there is more than one cause.
read_sections.body_fil:
Si Nestor, 41, ay nagsisiyasat sa missed visits ng tatlong pamilya sa halimbawa. Nakikipag-usap siya sa mga residente at health-center staff bago magmungkahi.

Tanungin kung bakit hindi nakarating, saka kung bakit nangyari ang ibinigay na dahilan. Sa kathang-isip na halimbawa, walang magbabantay sa anak; kasabay ng pagpasok sa trabaho ang schedule; iisang oras lang ang naipabatid; hindi nasuri ang kakayahang dumalo ng pamilya. Mga posibleng paliwanag ito na dapat kumpirmahin kasama ang residente, BHW at health-center staff. Hindi paligsahan ang pag-abot sa eksaktong limang bakit. Huminto sa isang nasusuring sanhi; kung may dalawang dahilan, sundan ang dalawang sanga.

read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang Five Whys ay paghanap ng nasusuring sanhi kasama ang iba, hindi paulit-ulit na paninisi.

read_sections.body_en: The Reference Manual uses a child’s diarrhoea death to investigate connected barriers to care and safe water. objectives_fil: Sa kuwento ng hindi pagpunta sa health center, gumamit ng bukas na tanong, linawin ang isang detalye at kumpirmahin ang buod nang hindi isinusubo ang sagot.
objectives_en: Given a missed-visit story, use an open question, clarify one detail and confirm a summary without leading the answer.

read_sections.body_en: Gibs, a male BHW, talks with Liza, 29, about her missed health-center visit. This story is fictional. They have already agreed on the purpose, language and a comfortable place. “What happened when you could not attend?” Gibs asks. “I had nobody with me,” Liza replies. He gives her time to finish the story. “You mean you did not want to go?” already assumes a motive. An open invitation lets Liza describe events in her own words. Then clarify one needed detail. A yes-or-no answer can confirm a specific detail; it does not replace listening to the story.
read_sections.body_fil: Si Gibs, lalaking BHW, ay nakikipag-usap kay Liza, 29 anyos, tungkol sa hindi niya pagpunta sa health center. Kathang-isip ang kuwentong ito. Napag-usapan na nila ang layunin, wika at komportableng lugar. “Ano po ang nangyari noong hindi kayo nakapunta?” tanong ni Gibs. “Wala akong kasama,” sagot ni Liza. Nagbigay siya ng oras para matapos ang kuwento. Ang “Ibig ninyong sabihin, ayaw ninyong pumunta?” ay may ipinapalagay nang motibo. Ang bukas na paanyaya ay nagbibigay kay Liza ng pagkakataong magsabi sa sarili niyang salita. Saka lamang maglinaw ng isang kailangang detalye. Maaaring oo o hindi ang sagot kung isang tiyak na detalye ang kinukumpirma; hindi ito kapalit ng pakikinig sa kuwento.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Start with an open invitation, then ask one focused question without blame.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Bukas na paanyaya muna; saka isang tiyak at walang paratang na tanong.

read_sections.body_en: “I had nobody with me” is still unclear to Gibs. “Do you mean someone to travel with you?” he asks. “No. Someone to watch my child,” Liza corrects him. “Thank you for clarifying,” Gibs replies. He does not insist on his first interpretation. “What do you mean by with me?” is another useful question when the meaning is uncertain. Ask one question at a time; do not request the date, time and reason all at once. If relevant to the agreed task, follow with “When was that?” or “When was your last visit?” Do not guess a date the person cannot remember. In this story, first clarify who was unavailable and what their role was.
read_sections.body_fil: Hindi pa malinaw kay Gibs ang “Wala akong kasama.” “Kasama po ba sa biyahe ang ibig ninyo?” tanong niya. “Hindi po. Magbabantay sa anak ko,” pagwawasto ni Liza. “Salamat po sa paglilinaw,” tugon ni Gibs. Hindi niya ipinilit ang unang pagkaintindi. Maaari ring itanong ang “Ano po ang ibig ninyong sabihin sa kasama?” kung hindi pa tiyak ang kahulugan. Isa-isahin ang tanong; huwag sabay na hingin ang petsa, oras at dahilan. Kung kailangan sa napagkasunduang gawain, saka itanong ang “Kailan po iyon?” o “Kailan po kayo huling nakapunta?” Huwag hulaan ang petsang hindi maalala. Sa kuwentong ito, ang kailangang linawin muna ay kung sino ang wala at ano ang papel niya.
read_sections.takeaway_en: The person can correct your understanding; accept the correction.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Puwedeng iwasto ng kausap ang pagkaintindi mo; tanggapin ang pagwawasto.

read_sections.body_en: In Liza’s own account, nobody could watch her child that day. This differs from the neighbor’s claim, “She just does not want to go.” That is the neighbor’s statement, not Liza’s confirmed explanation. “Which part of getting there was difficult?” Gibs asks. Timing, childcare, language or access may be barriers; let the person explain. Do not turn possibilities into a list of expected answers. The Rosario case in Module 7 connects poverty, service gaps and misinformation. First clarify what the family was told, then separately ask what prevented them from getting help. A barrier does not prove laziness or disobedience. Ask only for details relevant to the agreed task. Do not promise childcare, transport or an appointment that has not been confirmed.
read_sections.body_fil: Sa sariling kuwento ni Liza, walang magbabantay sa anak noong araw na iyon. Iba ito sa sabi ng kapitbahay na “Ayaw lang niyang pumunta.” Sabi iyon ng kapitbahay, hindi kinumpirmang paliwanag ni Liza. “Aling bahagi po ng pagpunta ang naging mahirap?” tanong ni Gibs. Maaaring oras, pag-aalaga, wika o pag-abot sa serbisyo ang hadlang; hayaang ang kausap ang magsabi. Huwag gawing listahan ng inaasahang sagot ang mga posibilidad. Sa kasong Rosario sa Modyul 7, magkakaugnay ang kahirapan, kakulangan sa serbisyo at maling impormasyon. Linawin muna kung ano ang sinabi sa pamilya, saka hiwalay na itanong kung ano ang pumigil sa pagkuha ng tulong. Hindi patunay ng katamaran o pagsuway ang hadlang. Kunin lamang ang kaugnay na detalye para sa napagkasunduang gawain. Huwag mangako ng childcare, sasakyan o appointment na hindi pa nakumpirma.

read_sections.body_en: “Have I understood correctly: getting there is always difficult because nobody can watch your child?” Gibs asks. “Not always. Gibs removes always from his summary. “Would you like us to check the current service hours?” he offers. Liza agrees to check the hours first; she does not yet know when she can attend. This is a confirmed next step, not a promise of an appointment or childcare. Return a brief relevant summary, not every private detail. Use information for the authorized purpose under local policy. If immediate help is needed, follow the local process; do not delay it to finish a routine conversation.
read_sections.body_fil: “Tama po ba: palaging mahirap pumunta dahil walang magbabantay?” tanong ni Gibs. “Hindi palagi. Kapag wala lang ang kapatid ko,” pagwawasto ni Liza. “Kapag wala ang kapatid ninyo, mahirap makahanap ng magbabantay sa anak. Tama po ba?” “Opo,” kinumpirma niya. ## [purpose] Layunin

Sanayin ang bukas na paanyaya, isang kaugnay at walang paratang na paglilinaw, sagot na puwedeng iwasto, at kinumpirmang inayos na buod. Panatilihin ang eksaktong objective ng 1.6.2. Hindi ito aralin sa diagnosis, teach-back o pormal na reporting.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

90 guided minutes: 10 pambungad + 15 demonstration + 30 tatlong round + 20 pag-ulit/pagwawasto + 10 debrief + 5 exit check = 90. Bahagi ito ng 90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90 = 480 minuto; hindi dagdag sa parehong walong-oras na programa. Maghanda ng cards at question aid para sa sampung triad, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na resident record. Maaaring offline at walang projector. Ginawang pagtataya ng sariling pag-aaral: 10–13 minuto, ayon sa mas mahabang salaysay. Aktuwal na salaysay ng anim na screen: 363.99 segundo sa English at 394.34 segundo sa Filipino; maglaan ng 3–6 minuto para sa check, maikling pagsasanay at pagninilay. Dagdag pa ang opsyonal na kuwento o pag-ulit.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Para sa 30 kalahok, bumuo ng sampung triad. Ibigay sa resident role lamang ang sagot at pagwawasto; huwag ibigay agad sa BHW. Ipaliwanag na kathang-isip ang lahat. Suriin ang gustong wika at suporta sa pagbabasa. Ipaalam na hindi kailangan ang personal na pagsisiwalat o sapilitang eye contact. Kumpirmahin sa lokal na health team ang awtorisadong layunin, access at agarang-tulong na proseso bago gamitin sa tunay na pagbisita.

## [opening] Pambungad · 10 minuto

Itanong: “Ano ang kaibhan ng Ano ang nangyari? at Ayaw mo bang pumunta?” Humingi ng dalawang halimbawa ng ipinapalagay na motibo. Ipakita ang unresolved check scene; huwag ibigay ang ending. Sabihin: “Ang hadlang ay impormasyon. Liza ang magpapaliwanag, hindi tayo ang huhula.” Iugnay nang maikli sa magalang na pakikinig sa 1.6.1.

## [steps] Demonstration · 15 minuto

Basahin ang open-question at clarify-detail. Ipakita ang maling interpretasyong kasama sa biyahe, saka hayaang iwasto ni Liza. Eksaktong sequence: “Ano po ang nangyari?” → “Wala akong kasama.” → “Kasama po ba sa biyahe?” → “Hindi. Magbabantay sa anak.” → “Salamat po sa paglilinaw.” Ipakita ang confirm-summary: palagi → hindi palagi → kapag wala ang kapatid → “Tama po ba?” → kinumpirmang oras muna ang aalamin. Itanong: “Aling salita ang binago? Saan tinanggap ang pagwawasto?” Huwag ilarawan itong sipi ng DOH; ginawa itong dialogue para sa aralin.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang bukas na paanyaya ay hindi naglalagay ng motibo. Magbabantay sa anak, hindi kasama sa biyahe, ang ibig sabihin sa unang round. Sa ikalawa, hapon noong araw na iyon ang ibig sabihin; hindi lahat ng hapon. Sa ikatlo, sabi ng kapitbahay ang ayaw; sariling sagot ni Liza ang hindi malinaw na oras ng serbisyo. Ang oras/petsa na hindi maalala o serbisyo na hindi pa natiyak ay mananatiling hindi tiyak. Ang corrected summary ay dapat ipasuri kay Liza.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Mga halimbawa: “Ayaw mo lang?”; tatlong tanong nang sabay; pagpapalit ng minsan tungo sa palagi; pagpilit sa unang hula; pagtrato sa sabi ng kapitbahay bilang sagot ni Liza; pag-imbento ng petsa, appointment o childcare. Tugon: huminto, itanong ang isang kaugnay na detalye, hintayin ang sagot, ibalik ang binagong buod. Hindi masama ang oo/hindi para sa tiyak na detalye; hindi nito mapapalitan ang bukas na paanyaya.

## [practice] Tatlong round · 30 minuto; retry · 20 minuto

Bawat round ay 10 minuto: 1 basahin ang role cards, 4 pag-uusap, 2 eksaktong feedback, 3 pag-ulit. Round 1: BHW A / Liza B / observer C. Round 2: BHW B / Liza C / observer A. Round 3: BHW C / Liza A / observer B. Lahat ay BHW minsan. Direktang obserbahan ng facilitator ang triad 1–3 sa unang round, 4–6 sa ikalawa, 7–10 sa ikatlo; ang hindi nasaksihang performance ng ibang learner ay not observed. Sa 20-minutong retry, magbigay ng tiyak na prompt at ulitin ang buong sequence; magtakda ng susunod na direct observation para sa hindi nasaksihan. Debrief 10 minuto: “Aling hula ang itinama? Ano ang hindi pa alam? Anong susunod na hakbang lang ang kinumpirma?”

## [answer-key] Exit check · 5 minuto

Una: “Ano ang nakaabala sa iyo noong araw na iyon?” ay nagbibigay ng puwang para sa sariling paliwanag ni Liza. Ikalawa: “Ayaw mong pumunta?” ay ipinapalagay ang motibo bago marinig ang sagot. Ikatlo: ang tanong tungkol sa paalala ay nililimitahan agad ang kuwento sa isang posibleng dahilan. Sa kathang-isip na pagpapatuloy, sinabi ni Liza, “Walang magbabantay sa anak ko.” “Noong araw lang po na iyon?” paglilinaw ni Gibs. “Opo, wala ang kapatid ko noon.” “Noong araw na iyon, walang magbabantay dahil wala ang kapatid ninyo. Tama po ba?” Kinumpirma ni Liza ang buod. Pumayag siyang alamin muna nila ang kasalukuyang oras ng serbisyo; hindi pa nakumpirma ang petsa ng pagpunta. Walang ipinangakong appointment o childcare.

Sa huling 5 minuto, pumili muna ang bawat kalahok at ipaliwanag; saka lamang basahin ang lahat ng rationale at ending. Ang MCQ ay hindi direct performance evidence.

## [observe] Direktang obserbasyon

Isang indicator sa objective_index 0: bukas na paanyaya → isang kaugnay na neutral na paglilinaw → puwang sa sagot/pagwawasto → kinumpirmang corrected summary. Itala ang eksaktong linya, round, observer at prompt. Kaya na: kumpletong independent sequence. Kailangan practice: nagawa nang may prompt o kailangang ulitin ang buod. Hindi pa: sa aktuwal na attempt, ipinilit ang motibo o maling buod. No evidence / not observed ay hiwalay na status; huwag gawing hindi pa ang kawalan ng pagmamasid. Peer feedback, completion at panonood ay hindi facilitator grade o certification.

## [support] Mga alternatibo at suporta

Kung mag-isa, isulat at basahin ang magkabilang papel gamit ang question aid; practice lamang ito, magtakda pa rin ng direct observation. Walang internet o projector: gamitin ang printed cards at basahin ang dialogue. Magbigay ng reading assistant, mas malaking print, dagdag na paghinto, o pasalita/pasulat na sagot sa gustong wika. Pareho ang standard; hindi dapat assistant ang sumagot para sa learner. Walang personal na disclosure o resident upload.

## [sources-review] Mga sanggunian at review

BHW Reference Manual PDF 18: communication passage na hiwalay sa naunang self-management; PDF 19: pakikinig at open-ended questions; PDF 30: privacy at paggalang sa pagkakaiba. DOH Facilitator Guide PDF 28 / printed 21: pangangalap/pagsusuri/pagpapahayag at combined eight hours; Day 1 slides 52–57: demonstration at scenario. Dialogue, round allocation, 90-minutong plano at cards ay authored adaptations. NPC IRR sections 18–20: transparency, legitimate purpose at proportionality; kailangang suriin ang lokal na patakaran sa awtorisadong gamit at agarang tulong. Hindi bagong certification requirement. Art, aktuwal na audio, human listening at owner/SME review ay hiwalay; tingnan ang target review receipts.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Rehearse an open invitation, one relevant neutral clarification, room for an answer or correction, and a confirmed corrected summary. Keep the exact 1.6.2 objective. This is not diagnosis, teach-back or formal reporting.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

90 guided minutes: 10 opening + 15 demonstration + 30 three-round triads + 20 retry/correction + 10 debrief + 5 exit check = 90. This is part of 90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90 = 480 minutes, not an additional eight-hour program. Prepare cards and question aids for ten triads, paper and pens. No real resident records. Internet and a projector are optional. Authored independent estimate: 10–13 minutes, using the longer language track. Actual six-screen narration is 363.99 seconds in English and 394.34 seconds in Filipino; allow 3–6 minutes for the check, brief rehearsal and reflection. Optional story or replay is additional.

## [prepare] Prepare

For 30 participants, form ten triads. Give the answer and correction only to the resident role; the BHW should not receive them in advance. Explain that every scenario is fictional. Check preferred language and reading support. Personal disclosure and forced eye contact are unnecessary. Confirm the authorized purpose, access and urgent-help process with the local health team before using this in an actual visit.

## [opening] Opening · 10 minutes

Ask: “How does What happened? differ from Did you not want to go?” Invite two examples of assumed motives. Show the unresolved check scene without its ending. Say: “A barrier is information. Liza explains; we do not guess.” Briefly connect to respectful listening in 1.6.1.

## [steps] Demonstration · 15 minutes

Read open-question and clarify-detail. Demonstrate the incorrect travel-companion interpretation, then allow Liza to correct it. Exact sequence: “What happened?” → “I had nobody with me.” → “Someone to travel with you?” → “No. Someone to watch my child.” → “Thank you for clarifying.” Demonstrate confirm-summary: always → not always → when my sister is away → “Is that right?” → agreement to check hours first. Ask: “Which word changed? Where was the correction accepted?” This dialogue is an authored adaptation, not a DOH quotation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

An open invitation does not supply a motive. Round one means childcare, not a travel companion. Round two means that afternoon, not every afternoon. In round three, unwillingness is the neighbor’s claim; unclear service hours are Liza’s own answer. A forgotten date or an unchecked service stays uncertain. Liza must be asked to confirm the corrected summary.

## [misconception] Common errors

Examples: “You just do not want to?”; three questions at once; turning sometimes into always; insisting on a first guess; treating the neighbor’s statement as Liza’s answer; inventing a date, appointment or childcare. Response: pause, ask one relevant detail, allow an answer, and return the corrected summary. Yes/no can confirm a detail; it cannot replace an open invitation.

## [practice] Three rounds · 30 minutes; retry · 20 minutes

Each round takes 10 minutes: 1 to read cards, 4 for conversation, 2 for exact feedback, 3 to retry. Round 1: BHW A / Liza B / observer C. Round 2: BHW B / Liza C / observer A. Round 3: BHW C / Liza A / observer B. Everyone practices as BHW once. The facilitator directly samples triads 1–3 in round one, 4–6 in round two, and 7–10 in round three; unobserved performances of other learners remain not observed. During the 20-minute retry, give a precise prompt and repeat the sequence; schedule later direct observation for unsampled learners. Debrief for 10 minutes: “Which guess was corrected? What remains unknown? Which next step alone was confirmed?”

## [answer-key] Exit check · 5 minutes

First: “What got in the way that day?” gives Liza room to explain in her own words. Second: “You did not want to go?” assumes a motive before hearing her answer. Third: the reminder question immediately limits the story to one possible cause. In the fictional continuation, Liza says, “Nobody could watch my child.” “Only on that day?” Gibs clarifies. “Yes, my sister was away then.” “On that day, nobody could watch your child because your sister was away. Is that right?” Liza confirms the summary. She agrees to check the current service hours first; the date of her visit is still unconfirmed. No appointment or childcare is promised.

In the final 5 minutes, each participant chooses and explains first; only then read every rationale and the ending. The MCQ does not establish direct performance evidence.

## [observe] Direct observation

One indicator at objective_index 0: open invitation → one relevant neutral clarification → room for an answer/correction → confirmed corrected summary. Record exact words, round, observer and prompts. Ready: complete independent sequence. Needs practice: sequence achieved with prompts or summary needs a retry. Not yet: in an observed attempt, insists on a motive or incorrect summary. No evidence / not observed is a separate status; absence of observation is not a low performance grade. Peer feedback, completion and watching are not facilitator grading or certification.

## [support] Alternatives and support

Alone, write and read both roles with the question aid; this is practice, and direct observation still needs arranging. Without internet or a projector, use printed cards and read the dialogue. Offer a reading assistant, larger print, pauses, or spoken/written responses in the preferred language. Keep the same standard; an assistant must not answer for the learner. No personal disclosure or resident upload.

## [sources-review] Sources and review

BHW Reference Manual PDF 18: communication passage, separately from preceding self-management; PDF 19: listening and open-ended questions; PDF 30: privacy and respect for differences. DOH Facilitator Guide PDF 28 / printed 21: gathering/assessing/presenting and the combined eight hours; Day 1 slides 52–57: demonstration and scenarios. Dialogue, rounds, the 90-minute allocation and cards are authored adaptations. NPC IRR sections 18–20: transparency, legitimate purpose and proportionality; local authorized-use and urgent-help procedures require review. No new certification requirement. Art, actual audio, human listening and owner/SME review are separate; consult the target review receipts.

read_sections.body_en: BHW Nestor, 41, revisits three households that missed an agreed health-center visit. Instead of labeling them “uncooperative,” he records dates, missed visits and the residents’ stated reasons. These three households are a training example, not data from your barangay. The problem is inability to reach a service on the agreed day; its causes still need investigation before choosing a solution.
read_sections.body_fil: Si BHW Nestor, 41 anyos, ay bumalik sa tatlong kabahayang hindi nakadalo sa napagkasunduang health-center visit. Sa halip na isulat na “pasaway,” inilista niya ang petsa, bilang ng hindi nakadalo at mga dahilang mismong sinabi ng residente. Ang tatlong kabahayan ay halimbawa sa pagsasanay, hindi datos ng inyong barangay. Ang problema ay “hindi makarating sa serbisyo sa takdang araw”; kailangan pang siyasatin ang dahilan bago pumili ng solusyon.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Define the problem using events and evidence rather than judgments about people.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Tukuyin ang problema gamit ang pangyayari at ebidensya, hindi husga sa tao.

read_sections.body_en: “Three households missed visits” describes the event in the example. “They did not want to go” guesses at motivation. “We need a poster” proposes a solution. Before choosing a solution, find out what each household reports and which records can clarify the situation.
read_sections.body_fil: “Tatlong pamilya ang hindi nakapunta” ay paglalarawan ng pangyayari sa halimbawa. “Ayaw nilang pumunta” ay hula sa motibo. “Kailangan ng poster” ay mungkahing solusyon. Bago pumili ng solusyon, alamin ang sinabi ng bawat pamilya at kung anong rekord ang makatutulong sa paglilinaw.

## [purpose] Layunin

Mula sa missed-visit case, isulat ang problemang may tiyak na pangyayari, pinagmulan at impormasyong kulang, nang walang paninisi.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

35 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 3 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang dalawang pahayag sa practice bilang mga card. Ang bilang na tatlo ay halimbawa lamang.

## [opening] Pambungad

Aling pahayag ang magandang simula ng pagsisiyasat?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang ikatlong sagot ay tiyak at bukas sa ebidensya. Ang poster ay solusyong hindi pa nasusuri; ang pahayag tungkol sa kagustuhan ay husga, hindi obserbasyon.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Husga sa pamilya o napiling solusyon ang ipinapalit sa problema. Ilarawan muna ang pangyayari at ebidensya bago pumili ng dahilan o solusyon.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Isulat: “Tatlong pamilya sa halimbawa ang hindi nakapunta sa napagkasunduang araw; ayon sa kanila, may hadlang sa pagpunta. Kailangan pang linawin ang petsa at bawat hadlang.” Ihambing sa “Walang disiplina ang mga pamilya.” Sa pares, salungguhitan ang pangyayari, pinagmulan at kulang. Kung mag-isa, gamitin ang parehong checklist. Sa susunod na problemang iuulat, humingi rin ng pananaw ng apektadong residente.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

3. “Tatlong pamilya ang hindi nakapunta; alamin ang hadlang sa bawat isa.”

Ang ikatlong sagot ay tiyak at bukas sa ebidensya. Ang poster ay solusyong hindi pa nasusuri; ang pahayag tungkol sa kagustuhan ay husga, hindi obserbasyon.

## [observe] Obserbahan

Isinusulat ang tiyak na pangyayari at saklaw; tinutukoy ang pinagmulan; pinapangalanan ang isang kulang na impormasyon; walang paninisi.

Kaya na: Isinusulat ang tiyak na pangyayari at saklaw; tinutukoy ang pinagmulan; pinapangalanan ang isang kulang na impormasyon; walang paninisi. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: May pangyayari ngunit walang pinagmulan o kulang; ipatanong kung sino ang nagsabi at ano pa ang dapat alamin.

Hindi pa: Husga sa pamilya o napiling solusyon ang ipinapalit sa problema.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

May pangyayari ngunit walang pinagmulan o kulang; ipatanong kung sino ang nagsabi at ano pa ang dapat alamin. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 29; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 19, 20, 21. Ang source table ay larawan; minana ang beripikadong interpretasyon ng naunang implementation plan. Ang Rosario case ay hiwalay na ZFF source. Hindi clinical advice ang kasaysayan. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

Given the missed-visit case, write a problem statement with a specific event, source and information gap, without blame.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

35 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 3 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare the two practice statements as cards. The count of three is fictional.

## [opening] Opening

Which statement is a useful starting point for investigation?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The third statement is specific and open to evidence. A poster is an untested solution; the claim about motivation is a judgment, not an observation.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Substitutes a judgment about families or a chosen solution for the problem. Describe the event and evidence before choosing a cause or solution.

## [practice] Practice activity

Write: “Three households in the example missed agreed visits; they report barriers to attending. Dates and each barrier still need clarification.” Compare with “The families lack discipline.” In pairs, underline the event, source and gap. Alone, use the same checklist. In your next problem report, seek the affected residents’ perspectives too.

## [answer-key] Answer key

3. “Three households missed visits; check each household’s barrier.”

The third statement is specific and open to evidence. A poster is an untested solution; the claim about motivation is a judgment, not an observation.

## [observe] Observe

States the event and scope, identifies the source, names one information gap and avoids blame.

Ready: States the event and scope, identifies the source, names one information gap and avoids blame. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Names an event but not its source or gap; ask who reported it and what still needs checking.

Not yet: Substitutes a judgment about families or a chosen solution for the problem.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Names an event but not its source or gap; ask who reported it and what still needs checking. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 29; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 19, 20, 21. The source table is an image; this draft inherits the earlier implementation plan’s verified interpretation. Rosario is a separate ZFF case source. The historical account is not clinical advice. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

read_sections.body_en: Gibs, a male BHW, visits Liza, 29, for a household profile. A neighbor sits beside Liza and answers for her. Liza gives short replies and looks toward the door. These cues do not tell Gibs for certain how she feels. He pauses the questions. Before continuing, what should he check about Liza’s comfort and choices?
read_sections.body_fil: Si Gibs, isang lalaking BHW, ay bumisita kay Liza, 29 anyos, para sa household profile. Katabi ni Liza ang kapitbahay na sumasagot para sa kanya. Maikli ang sagot ni Liza at tumitingin siya sa pinto. Hindi nito tiyak na sinasabi kung ano ang nararamdaman niya. Huminto muna si Gibs sa pagtatanong. Bago magpatuloy, ano ang dapat niyang alamin tungkol sa ginhawa at pagpili ni Liza?
read_sections.takeaway_en: Pause and ask what the person prefers; do not guess the reason for silence.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Huminto at itanong ang gusto ng kausap; huwag hulaan ang dahilan ng katahimikan.

read_sections.body_en: Gibs explains: “This is for an authorized household profile and health-service planning. Only relevant information will be used by the authorized health team under local policy. May we talk?” He asks about Liza’s preferred language, place and whether she wants a support person present. “Here in the quieter part, in Filipino, just us for now,” Liza replies. She may pause, leave a question unanswered for now or choose another time. Gibs does not promise absolute secrecy. If immediate help is needed, do not delay it to complete a routine interview; follow the local process.
read_sections.body_fil: Ipinaliwanag ni Gibs: “Para po ito sa awtorisadong household profile at pagpaplano ng serbisyong pangkalusugan. Kaugnay na impormasyon lamang ang gagamitin ng awtorisadong health team ayon sa lokal na patakaran. Maaari po ba tayong mag-usap?” Tinanong niya ang gustong wika, lugar at kung nais ni Liza ng kasamang susuporta sa kanya. “Dito po sa mas tahimik na bahagi, sa Filipino, tayo muna,” sagot ni Liza. Maaari siyang magpahinga, hindi muna sumagot o pumili ng ibang oras. Hindi pangako ng ganap na lihim ang paliwanag ni Gibs. Kung kailangan ng agarang tulong, huwag itong ipagpaliban para makumpleto ang karaniwang interview; sundin ang lokal na proseso.
read_sections.heading_fil: Humingi ng pahintulot at mag-alok ng pagpili
read_sections.takeaway_en: The person chooses a comfortable place, language and support person.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ang kausap ang pumipili ng komportableng lugar, wika at kasama.

read_sections.body_en: Gibs sits at Liza’s level and puts his phone away. “What would you like to tell me about getting to the health center?” he asks. He allows time and does not interrupt. Liza says getting there is difficult when nobody can look after her child. “It sounds difficult to manage caregiving and getting there,” Gibs replies. He does not call Liza lazy or promise to fix everything. He uses a calm voice and allows pauses. Do not force eye contact; comfortable listening is not measured by staring.
read_sections.body_fil: Umupo si Gibs nang kapantay ni Liza at itinabi ang telepono. “Ano po ang gusto ninyong ikuwento tungkol sa pagpunta sa health center?” tanong niya. Nagbigay siya ng oras at hindi sumabat. Sinabi ni Liza na mahirap pumunta kapag walang magbabantay sa anak. “Mukhang mahirap pagsabayin ang pag-aalaga at pagpunta roon,” tugon ni Gibs. Hindi niya tinawag na tamad si Liza o nangakong maaayos ang lahat. Gumamit siya ng mahinahong boses at sapat na paghinto. Huwag pilitin ang eye contact; ang komportableng pakikinig ay hindi sinusukat sa pagtitig.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Allow time for the account and acknowledge difficulty without blame.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Magbigay ng oras sa kuwento at kilalanin ang hirap nang walang paratang.

read_sections.body_en: “Have I understood correctly: getting there is difficult when nobody can look after your child?” Gibs asks. “Yes, when my sister is away,” Liza clarifies. Gibs offers a more accurate summary: “When your sister is away, it is difficult to find childcare. Is that right?” Liza confirms it. This is a fictional accuracy check, not an actual record. In an authorized profile, collect only relevant information, do not guess missing answers and respect a wish not to answer yet. No childcare arrangement or appointment has been promised.
read_sections.body_fil: “Tama po ba ang pagkaintindi ko: mahirap pumunta kapag walang magbabantay sa anak ninyo?” tanong ni Gibs. “Opo, kapag wala ang kapatid ko,” paglilinaw ni Liza. Ibinalik ni Gibs ang mas tumpak na buod: “Kapag wala ang kapatid ninyo, mahirap makahanap ng magbabantay. Tama po ba?” Kinumpirma ito ni Liza. Kathang-isip na halimbawa ito ng pagtitiyak, hindi aktuwal na rekord. Sa awtorisadong profile, kunin lamang ang kaugnay na impormasyon, huwag hulaan ang patlang at igalang ang ayaw munang sagutin. Walang ipinangakong childcare o appointment.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Ask whether the summary is accurate and let the person correct it.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Tanungin kung tama ang buod at hayaan ang kausap na magwasto.

read_sections.body_en: Use the fictional role cards: Gibs, Liza and observer. Rehearse permission, choice of place and language, listening without interruption, and a summary with an accuracy check. Liza chooses whether she wants a support person. The observer records the exact helpful phrase and any rushed step. Repeat that part before rotating roles. Everyone practices as the BHW. Alone, say both roles aloud and check the listening aid. At the next authorized visit, rehearse the same opening. Do not upload a resident’s private account.
read_sections.body_fil: Gamitin ang kathang-isip na role cards: Gibs, Liza at tagamasid. Magsanay ng pahintulot, pagpili ng lugar at wika, pakikinig nang hindi sumasabat, at buod na may pagtiyak. Si Liza ang pipili kung may kasamang susuporta. Itala ng tagamasid ang eksaktong linyang nakatulong at ang hakbang na minadali. Ulitin ang bahaging iyon bago magpalit ng papel. Lahat ay susubok bilang BHW. Kung mag-isa, sabihin nang malakas ang dalawang papel at itsek ang listening aid. Sa susunod na awtorisadong pagbisita, sanayin ang parehong pambungad. Huwag mag-upload ng pribadong kuwento ng residente.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Repeat the step needing work; peer feedback is practice.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Ulitin ang hindi pa malinaw na hakbang; feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay.

read_sections.body_en: Return to the scene: the neighbor answers for Liza. Gibs holds a closed clipboard. He has not yet checked where, in which language and with whom Liza feels comfortable talking. Choose the first step and explain your reason before viewing feedback. Then compare your decision with your practice attempt.
read_sections.body_fil: Bumalik sa tagpo: ang kapitbahay ang sumasagot para kay Liza. Hawak ni Gibs ang nakasarang clipboard. Hindi pa niya alam kung saan, sa anong wika at kanino kasama komportable si Liza. Piliin ang unang hakbang at ipaliwanag ang dahilan bago tingnan ang feedback. Pagkatapos, ihambing ang pasya sa ginawa mo sa pagsasanay.
read_sections.takeaway_en: Give Liza a choice and a voice, then check understanding.
read_sections.takeaway_fil: Bigyan ng pagpili at boses si Liza, saka tiyakin ang pagkaintindi.
