## [purpose] Purpose

Sa kunwaring household interview, humingi ng pahintulot, pumili ng komportableng lugar at ibuod ang concern nang walang paratang.

## [time-materials] Time Materials

90 minuto ng gabay na pagsasanay sa iisang walong-oras na programa sa komunikasyon. Ang limang lesson allocation (90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90) at ang shared na 480-minute run sheet ay dalawang pagtingin sa parehong programa, hindi dagdag na oras. Ginawang allocation ang 90 minuto, hindi opisyal na hiwalay na minimum. I-print ang role cards nina Gibs at Liza, observer checklist at one-page listening aid sa practice kit. Gumamit ng papel at bolpen; walang tunay na personal na rekord. Ginawang pagtataya ng sariling pag-aaral: 8–11 minuto, ayon sa mas mahabang salaysay. Aktuwal na salaysay ng anim na screen: 253.83 segundo sa English at 276.90 segundo sa Filipino; maglaan ng 3–6 minuto para sa check, maikling pagsasanay at pagninilay. Dagdag pa ang opsyonal na kuwento o pag-ulit.

## [prepare] Prepare

Maghanda ng sampung triad para sa 30 kalahok, may bilang na 1–10. Tiyakin sa lokal na team ang awtorisadong layunin, paggamit ng impormasyon, privacy at proseso ng agarang tulong. Kathang-isip ang lahat ng papel at detalye. I-print ang kit bago ang session na walang internet. Kung walang projector, basahin ang tagpo at ipasa ang mga larawan. Puwedeng pasalita o pasulat; magbigay ng tulong sa pagbasa.

## [opening] Opening

Pambungad at pagpili ng lugar, 10 minuto: ipakita ang masikip na tagpo. Ano ang dapat munang alamin ni Gibs? Ang pagtingin sa pinto o katahimikan ay dahilan para magtanong tungkol sa ginhawa, hindi diagnosis. Papiliin ang kalahok ng wika, lugar at gustong kasamang susuporta.

## [steps] Steps

Demonstrasyon, 15 minuto: pahintulot → lugar at wika → pakikinig nang hindi sumasabat → buod at pagtiyak. “Maaari po ba tayong mag-usap?” tanong ni Gibs. Pinili ni Liza ang mas tahimik na lugar at Filipino. Itinabi niya ang telepono, nagtanong nang bukas at nagbigay ng oras. Ikinuwento ni Liza ang hadlang sa pag-aalaga ng anak. Buod na tanong ang ginamit ni Gibs; idinagdag ni Liza “kapag wala ang kapatid ko,” at tiniyak niya ang mas tumpak na buod. Walang pangako ng childcare o appointment. Sa 1.6.2 ang detalyadong paglilinaw, sa 1.6.3 ang teach-back, sa 1.6.4 ang pagtatala at sa 1.6.5 ang pormal na handoff.

## [expected-answers] Expected Answers

Inaasahan: malinaw na layunin at kaugnay na awtorisadong gamit; pahintulot at pagpili; pakikinig nang walang pagsabat o paratang; buod na tanong na maaaring iwasto ni Liza. Opsyonal ang komportableng eye contact. Hindi awtomatikong tumpak ang sagot ng kapitbahay o mas maraming personal na detalye.

## [misconception] Misconception

Maling akala: “Walang sasabihin ang tahimik, kaya puwedeng iba na ang sumagot.” Itanong kay Liza kung paano magiging komportable ang usapan at ibalik sa kanya ang pagkakataong magsalita. Hindi patunay ng pagtanggi, panlilinlang, depression o abuse ang paghinto.

## [practice] Practice

Triad practice at pag-ikot ng papel, 30 minuto: tatlong round na tig-10 minuto. Bawat round: 6 minuto sa usapan, 2 sa feedback at 2 sa pag-ulit ng kulang na hakbang. Magpalit bilang Gibs/BHW, Liza at tagamasid upang lahat ay sumubok bilang BHW. Direktang obserbahan ng assessor ang triad 1–3 sa round 1, 4–6 sa round 2 at 7–10 sa round 3; itala ang mismong taong gumanap bilang BHW na nakita. Feedback at pag-ulit, 20 minuto: unahin ang direktang obserbasyon ng hindi pa nakita. Kung kulang ang oras, markahang “hindi pa naobserbahan” at magtakda ng susunod na pagkakataon. Hindi assessor rating ang peer feedback. Kung mag-isa, sabihin ang dalawang papel, gamitin ang checklist at ulitin; magpaobserba kalaunan. Kathang-isip na detalye lamang.

## [answer-key] Answer Key

Check at pagninilay, 10 minuto. Tamang sagot: 2. Una: maaaring mali ang sagot ng kapitbahay para kay Liza; huwag itong gawing sagot niya. Ikalawa: tanungin si Liza tungkol sa ginhawa at pagpili upang siya mismo ang makapagsalita. Ito ang tamang unang hakbang. Ikatlo: ang payo bago makinig ay maaaring hindi tumugon sa tunay na concern. Sa wakas, pinili ni Liza ang mas tahimik na lugar at Filipino. Sinabi niyang mahirap pumunta kapag wala ang kapatid na nagbabantay sa anak. Ibinuod ito ni Gibs bilang tanong at kinumpirma ni Liza. Walang ipinangakong childcare o appointment. Hingin muna ang dahilan bago ipakita ang feedback. May nakasulat na paliwanag ang tatlong pagpipilian.

## [observe] Observe

Sa objective index 0, obserbahan: pahintulot; pagpili ng lugar at wika; pakikinig nang hindi sumasabat; buod sa sariling salita; pagtiyak kung tama. Markahan bilang nagawa / may prompt / hindi pa at itala ang eksaktong sinabi. Kaya na: lahat ng limang hakbang nang walang prompt. Kailangan ng practice: nakikinig ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa pahintulot o pagtiyak sa buod; ipaulit. Hindi pa: humuhula o tinatanggap ang sagot ng iba nang hindi kinakausap si Liza. Ihiwalay ang “hindi pa naobserbahan” sa “hindi pa kaya.” Hindi kapalit ng performance ang quiz.

## [support] Support

Paglipat sa gawain, 5 minuto: sanayin ang pambungad sa susunod na awtorisadong pagbisita, nang walang pag-upload ng pribadong kuwento. Kung walang internet, gamitin ang printed kit at demonstrasyon ng facilitator. Kung walang projector, basahin ang usapan at ipasa ang larawan. Sa solo practice, kathang-isip na rehearsal lamang ang itala. Igalang ang gustong wika, tulong sa pagbasa at pasulat na sagot; pareho ang limang pamantayan. Huwag ipagpaliban ang agarang tulong para sa pahintulot ng karaniwang interview; sundin ang lokal na proseso.

## [sources-review] Sources Review

BHW Reference Manual (2022), PDF18 sa komunikasyon at PDF19: komportableng lugar, walang pagsabat o pagmamadali, pakikinig, empathy, magalang na salita at bukas na tanong. PDF30: privacy at paggalang sa pagkakaiba. DOH Facilitator Guide (2022), PDF28 / printed21: pangangalap, pagsusuri, pagtatala/paglalahad, household role-play at walong oras ng pinagsamang competency. Presentation PDF52–57: komunikasyon at pagsasanay. Ginawang halimbawa ang usapan nina Gibs at Liza, opsyonal na eye contact, pagpili ng kasama, role cards at 90-minute run sheet. Tiyakin ang lokal na patakaran sa impormasyon at agarang tulong bago magturo. Walang bagong tuntunin sa certification.
private_notes.notes_en:
## [purpose] Purpose

In a simulated household interview, ask permission, establish a comfortable setting and summarize the concern without blame.

## [time-materials] Time Materials

90 minutes of guided practice within the same eight-hour communication program. The five lesson allocations (90 + 90 + 120 + 90 + 90) and the shared 480-minute run sheet are two views of one program, not additive hours. The 90-minute lesson allocation is authored, not an official standalone minimum. Print the Gibs/Liza role cards, observer checklist and one-page listening aid in the practice kit; use paper and pens. No real personal records. Authored independent estimate: 8–11 minutes, using the longer language track. Actual six-screen narration is 253.83 seconds in English and 276.90 seconds in Filipino; allow 3–6 minutes for the check, brief rehearsal and reflection. Optional story or replay is additional.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare ten triads for 30 participants, numbered 1–10. Confirm the authorized purpose, information use, privacy arrangements and urgent-help process with the local team. Explain that all roles and details are fictional. Print the kit before a no-internet session; without a projector, read the scene aloud and pass the printed illustrations. Offer spoken or written participation and reading assistance.

## [opening] Opening

Opening and setting choice, 10 minutes: show the crowded scene. Ask what Gibs needs to check before continuing. A glance or silence is a cue to ask about comfort, never a diagnosis. Let the participant choose language, place and support-person preferences.

## [steps] Steps

Worked demonstration, 15 minutes: model permission → setting/language → uninterrupted account → summary and accuracy check. Gibs says “May we talk?” Liza chooses the quieter place and Filipino. He puts his phone away, invites her account and allows a pause. Liza explains the childcare barrier. He asks whether his summary is right; she adds “when my sister is away” and he checks the corrected summary. No childcare or appointment is promised. Keep detailed clarification in 1.6.2, teach-back in 1.6.3, recording in 1.6.4 and formal handoff in 1.6.5.

## [expected-answers] Expected Answers

Expected: explain purpose and relevant authorized use; invite permission and choices; listen without interruption or blame; summarize as a question Liza can correct. Comfortable eye contact is optional. Neither a neighbor’s answer nor extra personal detail makes a profile accurate.

## [misconception] Misconception

Misconception: “A quiet person has nothing to say, so another person may answer for them.” Correct it by asking Liza what makes talking comfortable and returning the opportunity to her. A pause is not proof of refusal, deception, depression or abuse.

## [practice] Practice

Triad practice and rotation, 30 minutes: three 10-minute rounds. Each round gives 6 minutes for the conversation, 2 for observer feedback and 2 for repeating a missed step. Rotate Gibs/BHW, Liza and observer so everyone practices the BHW role. The assessor directly samples triads 1–3 in round 1, 4–6 in round 2 and 7–10 in round 3; record the individual BHW performances actually seen. Observer feedback and repeated attempts, 20 minutes: first arrange direct observation for the unsampled participants; if time is insufficient, record “not yet observed” and schedule another observed attempt. Peer feedback never supplies an assessor rating. Solo: speak both roles aloud using the kit, self-check, repeat; later obtain direct observation. Use fictional details only.

## [answer-key] Answer Key

Check and debrief, 10 minutes. Correct answer: 2. First: the neighbor’s answer may not be Liza’s; do not treat it as her answer. Second: ask Liza about comfort and choices so she can speak for herself. This is the correct first step. Third: advice before listening may miss the actual concern. In the ending, Liza chooses a quieter place and Filipino. She explains that visits are difficult when her sister cannot look after her child. Gibs summarizes this as a question and Liza confirms it. No childcare or appointment is promised. Ask for the reason before revealing feedback. All three choices have a written rationale.

## [observe] Observe

At objective index 0, observe permission; setting and language choice; time for an uninterrupted account; paraphrase; accuracy check. Mark each action done / prompted / not yet and record exact words. Ready: performs all five without prompting. Needs practice: listens but needs a prompt for permission or checking the summary; repeat that step. Not yet: guesses or accepts another person’s answers without consulting Liza. Keep “not observed” distinct from “not yet able.” A quiz answer cannot substitute for observed performance.

## [support] Support

Transfer action, 5 minutes: rehearse the opening for the next authorized visit, without uploading a resident’s private account. Without internet, use the printed kit and narrated demonstration by the facilitator. Without a projector, read dialogue aloud and pass pictures. For solo practice, record only your fictional rehearsal words. Allow preferred language, reading support and written responses; preserve the five action criteria. Ordinary interview permission must not delay urgent assistance under the local process.

## [sources-review] Sources Review

BHW Reference Manual (2022), PDF18 communication passage and PDF19: comfortable setting, no interruption/rushing, attentive listening, empathy, respectful words and open questions. PDF30: privacy and respect for differences. DOH Facilitator Guide (2022), PDF28 / printed21: gather, assess, record/present; household role-play and eight hours for the combined competency. Presentation PDF52–57: communication context and practice. Gibs/Liza dialogue, optional eye contact, choice of support person, role cards and the 90-minute run sheet are instructional adaptations. Confirm local information-use and urgent-help procedures before delivery. No new certification requirement.
